articleTitle: Pharmashield: Using Blockchain for Anti-Counterfeit Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Counterfeit drugs pose a significant and pressing global challenge, particularly in developing nations, where the production and distribution of these illicit products are rampant. A critical factor contributing to this issue is the inherent deficiencies within the pharmaceutical supply chain. As pharmaceuticals traverse from suppliers to manufacturers, distributors, and wholesalers, before reaching end consumers, the lack of information sharing among stakeholders creates opportunities for counterfeiting and compromises product integrity. In response to this challenge, this research work proposes leveraging blockchain technology to enhance traceability, visibility, and security within the pharmaceutical supply chain. By implementing a blockchain-based system, stakeholders in the pharmaceutical industry can effectively track the journey of drugs from their point of origin to their final destination, thus reducing the threats posed by counterfeit products.

articleTitle: Enhancing Road Safety: A Deep Learning Approach to Automated Crack Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Recently, the concept of transfer learning has been extensively utilized, demonstrating its efficacy across various tasks. Motivated by its success in image classification, this research presents a comparative analysis of road crack detection using transfer learning and Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). Three different architecture for road crack detection were explored. First two were based on transfer learning and third one was based on Artificial Neural Network (ANN). Transfer learning with VGG16, VGG19 for road crack detection was employed and the performance of these models was evaluated and compared with the performance of ANN based model. Before exploring these model’s architecture, this work also involves other steps: collecting crack and non-crack images from three different sources and preprocessed them. The dataset consists of 42,266 crack and non-crack images. Then, the model based on VGG16 was trained on this dataset and achieved 98.55% validation accuracy. VGG19 and ANN based models were also trained on same dataset and achieved 99.01% and 98.94% validation accuracy respectively. The learning rate of these three models was set to 0.001.

articleTitle: Navigating Tomorrow’s Engagement: A Comprehensive Social Media Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Social media has become an effective vehicle for worldwide interaction in the rapidly evolving world of technology. Nowadays, large number of Content creators, celebrities, and influencers use these platforms to distribute thoughts, knowledge, and skills to a vast audience. This kind of people requires constant monitoring the engagement metrics such as likes, comments, and followers which is crucial to assess the impact of the content on the intended audience. To address their need, this system aims to provide a comprehensive solution for individuals managing multiple social media accounts. The system dashboard provides a user friendly and clean front-end to the user. On the other side, the platform processes data acquired from various social media platforms seamlessly. It aims to provide users with a user-friendly and clean front-end interface for managing multiple social media accounts. The platform predicts future reach and estimates potential follower growth using data science algorithms such as regression and random forest. The accuracy of the prediction algorithm obtained from linear or multiple regression is about 63 to 73%, and from random forest, it can be up to 92%. This approach empowers social media managers with actionable insights, aiding them in optimizing their content strategy and enhancing their online presence. Currently, this research focuses only on the Instagram platform, but the same techniques can be used to develop web-based system for other platforms as well. Additionally, dataset for Instagram is created to train the proposed models.

articleTitle: Smart Monitoring and Control of Hydroponic Systems Using IoT Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Hydroponics, a method of growing plants without soil, offers a viable solution for agricultural production in areas with limited space or adverse soil conditions. This soil-less cultivation method circumvents the lengthy decomposition process associated with traditional soil-based agriculture, reducing the risk of disease and the associated costs. This study introduces a sophisticated Internet of Things (IoT) framework designed to optimize the monitoring and management of hydroponic systems. The core of this system is a suite of multimodal sensors that continuously measure critical environmental and nutritional parameters such as temperature, humidity, nutrient levels, pH, and water levels. These sensors are integrated with a microcontroller that collects and transmits data to a cloud-based platform for storage and further analysis. Furthermore, an interactive website allows users to access this data remotely and adjust the system settings based on real-time information. The system also incorporates an automated control mechanism that adjusts the environment of the hydroponic system based on sensor inputs and predefined algorithms, ensuring optimal plant growth conditions. By providing a comprehensive and adaptive approach to hydroponic management, this IoT-based system enhances the efficiency and effectiveness of hydroponic farming, making it adaptable to various setups and scalable for different operational sizes. This study demonstrates the potential of integrating advanced technologies like IoT into agricultural practices to enhance productivity and sustainability.

articleTitle: IoT-based Precision Agriculture Monitoring System: Enhancing Agricultural Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research study introduces an IoT-based Agricultural Monitoring System designed to enhance precision farming practices. Employing Arduino microcontrollers and a network of sensors including water level, soil moisture, temperature, and pH, the system enables real-time monitoring of agricultural parameters. Integration with GSM and WiFi modules facilitates data communication and remote-control capabilities. Additionally, solar power integration enhances sustainability. The collected data is uploaded to a cloud platform for analysis, providing farmers with actionable insights for informed decision-making. The study aims to optimize resource utilization, improve crop yield, and promote sustainable agriculture practices.

articleTitle: Strategies for VAWT Optimisation in Highway Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: As a developing country like India continues to experience urbanization, technological advancements and growth in industrial sectors, the demand for energy is also increasing. Not only the energy demands are increasing but there is also a growing need for clean and sustainable energy. The wind power has been emerged as leading factor in India’s energy landscape. In the current situation on highways, as vehicles pass along both sides of highways, a significant amount of kinetic energy is being wasted as it could be harnessed and transformed into wind energy. In the context of highways, traditional HAWTs’ face limitations as being bulky, tall and occupying significant space. Additionally, they generate noise and are less effective in low wind environments. Vertical Axis Wind Turbines (VAWTs) address these issues as they are compact, low-profile, cost-effective and occupy less space. Moreover, they are quieter more suitable for harnessing energy in low wind conditions, making them as a promising solution for energy generation along highways. Therefore, the objective of this research work is to propose a potential design for VAWT tailored specifically for Indian highways. This research investigates integrating deflectors into the original H-type VAWT design, considering various parameters such as aerodynamics, turbulence reduction and blade dimensions. It suggests optimal design for its deployment on Indian highways.

Author Keywords: potential design for Vertical Axis Wind Turbine (VAWT)

articleTitle: Mental Health Prediction using Machine Learning Models and Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Mental health is integral to overall well-being, impacting human ability to deal with challenges in life. Machine learning and AI hold promise in predicting mental illnesses by analysing behavioural patterns, aiding in early detection and intervention. This proactive approach can mitigate symptom escalation, improving mental health outcomes. This research study introduces a novel predictive framework integrating ensemble learning techniques and large language models (LLMs). Initially, ensemble learning, including AdaBoost, voting, and bagging, constructs a robust model with Random Forest emerging as optimal. Subsequently, a Large Language Model (LLM) enhances the pipeline. User input triggers mental health prediction by Random Forest, forwarded to a Google Gemini model via an API key, generating personalised insights, marking a significant advancement in mental health prediction.

articleTitle: Disease Detection and Dietary Suggestions using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Infectious diseases have posed a global threat to human health, while diet plays a pivotal role in managing such health challenges. Contemporary lifestyles often include sedentary behaviors, poor dietary practices, and heightened stress levels, all of which can elevate the risk of various chronic illnesses. The complexity among social, environmental, economic, and behavioral factors contributes to the escalating prevalence of diseases in modern society. Balancing these factors necessitates comprehensive public health strategies, encompassing the promotion of healthy lifestyle, enhancement of healthcare accessibility and sanitation, mitigation of environmental pollution, and addressing social and economic disparities. By employing modern technology, particularly machine learning will enable disease prediction by considering vast datasets to detect complex patterns. Leveraging diverse data types like medical records, genetic information, lifestyle factors, and environmental data, Machine Learning (ML) algorithms can construct predictive models for analyzing a wide spectrum of diseases. This study mainly focuses on disease prediction based on different symptoms, supplemented by dietary recommendations and disease descriptions facilitated by a random forest classifier. Overall, this study integrates machine learning algorithms with healthcare information to provide personalized disease predictions, dietary advice, and disease insights in order to make informed decisions concerning their health.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction using SMOTE and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research work explores highly sophisticated diabetes prediction algorithms employing the PIMA Indian Diabetes dataset. Proposed research intends to explore the influence of model update, assessment criteria, and data preparation on prediction algorithms. In this extensive research, a pre-selected dataset coupled with feature scaling, stratified selection, and oversampling is employed to tackle the issue of class imbalance. Through the use of advanced machine learning models like Random Forest, the research illustrates how modifying a component's features might enhance estimate accuracy. Using stratified shuffle split validation, the performance of the model is examined and discover large gains in accuracy, F-measure, precision, recall, and AUC. Proposed work underlines the necessity of data preparation for accurate diabetes prognosis and offers an example of outstanding Random Forest model construction.

articleTitle: Enhancing Skin Cancer Diagnosis with Ensemble Deep Convolutional Neural Networks: A Multi-Model Optimization Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study focuses about the identification and classification of skin cancer. It involves the use of datasets that contain images with labels and classes. The research utilizes pre-trained convolutional neural network (CNN) models, as well as integrated models. Skin cancer, a neoplastic disorder, is commonly observed on sun-exposed skin due to the proliferation of aberrant skin cells. The three most common types of skin cancer are melanoma, basal cell carcinoma, and squamous cell carcinoma. As per the American Cancer Society, it is projected that the United States will witness 99,780 fresh cases of melanoma in the year 2022. Basal cell carcinoma constitutes more than 80% of all cases of skin cancer, rendering it the predominant type. The study utilizes deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models including VGG19, Xception, VGG16, InceptionV3, and ResNet50. These models are trained using image inputs that are resized to 224 x 224 pixels. The results of the segmentation algorithm can be evaluated using a combination of computational tools and clinical characteristics to accurately detect and categorize skin cancer.

articleTitle: Smart Tender Contract Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The Smart Tender Contract Management System utilizes Blockchain technology to support the security and integrity of tender data. Leveraging Blockchain's decentralized architecture and encryption capabilities, the system ensures data remains tamper-proof and resistant to unauthorized access. Each piece of data, along with its hash code, is securely stored in an RTREE structure, enabling continuous verification of transaction integrity. Before adding a new block to the Blockchain, the system rigorously verifies hash codes to ensure data integrity remains intact. Through the creation of contracts within the Blockchain, all transaction details are securely stored, ensuring immutability and encryption throughout the process. This robust approach guarantees data integrity, even in the face of potential server compromises, as verification and retrieval of data can be conducted from multiple functioning nodes within the Blockchain network. By leveraging Blockchain technology, the Smart Tender Contract Management System not only enhances the security and integrity of tender data but also ensures transparency, accountability, and resilience in the tendering process.

articleTitle: Crowdfunding for Environmental Projects: A Sustainable Approach to Community-Led Initiatives
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Crowdfunding has emerged as a powerful and innovative method for individuals, startups, and organizations to raise funds for their projects, causes, and creative endeavors. Managing crowdfunding campaigns efficiently and securely is crucial to ensuring the success of these initiatives. This research study proposes the development of a robust Crowdfunding Management System powered by a Database Management System to streamline the entire crowdfunding process. By leveraging a powerful DBMS, this Crowdfunding Management System will efficiently handle data storage, retrieval, and management, ensuring scalability, data integrity, and high performance. The DBMS will support structured data storage for user profiles, campaign details, transaction records, and more. The proposed Crowdfunding Management System aims to simplify the crowdfunding process for campaign creators and contributors alike, fostering a supportive and transparent crowdfunding ecosystem. It gives a secure and user-friendly platform and helps contributors to reach funding goals for their new ideas. The purpose of Crowdfunding management system is to support and implement new projects.

articleTitle: Securing Information Transfer with Hybrid Cryptography via Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Security of data is the foremost concern within cloud environments, given the prevalent trend among organizations to store their data there. This study concentrates on hybrid encryption methods, analyzing their implementation and effectiveness in cloud environments with a focus on performance enhancement, algorithm speed, efficacy evaluation, and comparison with existing methods. The research introduces a new hybrid algorithm that merges symmetric (Twofish) and asymmetric (RSA) cryptographic techniques. The study demonstrates the heightened security potential of the proposed Twofish+RSA hybrid algorithm. Additionally, it contrasts this with the AES+RSA approach, aiming to provide a balanced and secure data protection solution across different applications. Notably, the Twofish+RSA hybrid method excels in computation time, ciphertext size, and memory usage. The proposal of a multilayered cryptography-based security solution is driven by the increasing emphasis on cloud computing security in research. Security concerns are pervasive in today's technology-driven landscape, particularly in the realm of cloud computing, where vulnerabilities can be exploited by attackers. The transition from local to cloud storage further exacerbates these security challenges.

articleTitle: Investigation of Hand Gesture Recognition and Script Generation Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The communication between differently challenged persons especially deaf and mute persons to a common man is challenging. The research work proposes to investigate various deep learning models to enhance communication between the deaf and persons who may not know sign language. The work uses computer vision technology for real-time hand gesture identification and natural language processing to produce coherent and understandable words This article investigates the feasibility of applying deep learning techniques like convolutional neural networks, xgboost and random forest to recognize hand gestures in real-time. The models are trained on a dataset of hand gestures and are investigated to identify hand gestures in real-time. The model can recognize a wide range of hand motions, from simple ones like pointing and waving to complex ones involving several fingers. The system creates sentences that are consistent with the hand gesture's intended meaning once it has been identified. Based on established rules and grammar suggestions, the model tries to generate appropriate sentences while taking the context of the conversation into account. The proposed work would be highly beneficial to researchers and target audiences who have trouble expressing themselves in a quick, efficient way to communicate.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Fire Detection using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Timely detection of forest fires is critical for mitigating potential extensive damage, especially amid increasing occurrences driven by environmental changes and human activities. This study leverages satellite technology to capture thermal images of forested areas, employing image processing techniques to enhance data quality and identify potential fire regions. Pre-processing eliminates noise, while segmentation delineates distinct forest sub-areas, facilitating accurate fire detection. The proposed system integrates deep learning models including YOLOv5, YOLOv7, and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures for prediction. CNN's convolutional layers extract spatial features crucial for precise fire identification. Evaluation based on accuracy during training and testing phases using CNN algorithms demonstrates the proposed system's effectiveness, supported by the performance metrics analysis. This research contributes to advancing forest fire detection methodologies, aiding in timely intervention and mitigation efforts.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Anticipating Adverse Drug Reactions to ameliorate Drug Development and Prescription Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Integrating Artificial Intelligence into Health Care involves employing AI technologies and Algorithms to reinforce various facets of Medical Domain including discovery of the drugs and its subsequent development. However, with the advent of various drugs for several medical conditions, comes the side effects. This work aims to present a comprehensive approach to drug side effect prediction using a machine learning algorithm for Drug organization and analysis of extensive drug-related datasets. Utilizing advanced data-driven methodologies techniques, the system aims to predict potential side effects early in the drug development lifecycle. The repository used serves as a crucial infrastructure for managing diverse data, including information on drugs, chemical properties, and historical side effect records. The main objective of this research work is to enhance patient safety by minimizing adverse drug reactions and reducing treatment discontinuation rates, thereby mitigating the economic impact on pharmaceutical companies. The system enables informed decision-making throughout the drug development process by empowering researchers, healthcare practitioners, and regulatory bodies with an integrated decision-support the DBMS, acting as the backbone for the development of this predictive model. The proposed model integrated into drug development, aims to revolutionize drug safety practices, offering a proactive and data-driven approach. The predicted outcomes have broader implications for advancing healthcare technologies, optimizing drug development practices, and contributing to more efficient and informed pharmaceutical sciences.

articleTitle: An Improvement to the Existing Cloud-Enabled Medication Reminder Device
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Medication adherence remains a global challenge, negatively impacting health and increasing healthcare costs. A cloud-enabled medication reminder device presented in this research study addresses this issue. The proposed device includes motion sensors to detect missed doses, triggers multi-modal alerts (email, text, phone, LED, and Buzzer) for sending timely reminders and automatic refill requests to pharmacies. The presented results show the working and functionalities of the device. A study spanning over a month involving 30 human subjects assesses the effectiveness of the proposed system. The feedback received confirms the usefulness of the device. It shows a willingness among the participants to use the device and a likelihood to recommend it. The participants also highly rate the device in terms of helpfulness, reliability, management, and improvement in medication adherence.

articleTitle: Adaptive Digital Beam Forming for Massive Array Employed in the XOR MUX full Adder FPGA Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Improving the quality of communication is very necessary with recent technology. Include the building of 5G wireless networks and growth of various communication tools. A method known as adaptive digital beam forming is one that adjusts an antenna’s radiation pattern array inside response to a particular signal reception that is desired. An adaptation this is based on (LMS) and its variant continues to be one of creative strategies that are employed the most. The improvement of antennas has led to the creation of high-performance hardware, even though those LMS techniques provide impressive computing performance. Systems like (FPGAs)-Field Programmable Gate Arrays, which were developed used for large array system, provide designs that are both high-performance and efficient with regard to energy consumption. The proposed work in this study presents a parallel implementation of a vast array beam forming system utilizing LMS on FPGAs with conventional and XOR-MUX full adder designs. The beam-forming system consists of a spatial filter and an adaptation unit. This proposed work was developed at Verilog HDL, synthesized on a Xilinx A vertex- 5 FPGA, and evaluated every parameter concerning area, latency, and power consumption.

articleTitle: Enhanced Urban Infrastructure: IoT-based Sewer Vault Monitoring and Cautioning System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: A sewer vault monitoring and cautioning system has been developed by municipal corporation officials, offering advanced features for monitoring and cautioning purposes. Equipped with a DHT11 sensor, it detects changes in temperature and provides alerts through an APR33 A3 module and speaker located at the municipal corporation. Additional features include water overflow detection using water sensors, dangerous gas detection using an MQ2 sensor, and detection of manhole lid status using an IR sensor. An emergency button is also provided for immediate access during emergency situations. To enhance safety further, a copper transmitter coil is situated on the road to transmit signals to vehicles equipped with receiver copper coils. This enables drivers to identify the presence of manholes earlier and avoid driving over them, reducing accidents caused by damaged manholes. This integration of sensors provides robust safety for citizens and facilitates easier identification of damaged manholes within the city by municipal corporation.

articleTitle: A Novel Subway Automatic Ticket Inspection System Based on RFID Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study proposes a novel subway automatic ticket inspection system based on RFID devices, which aims to improve authentication efficiency in large-scale RFID systems. The system utilizes advanced RFID technology to automate ticketing processes, improve passenger convenience, and increase operational efficiency. The proposed system consists of automatic ticket vending machines and automatic ticket inspection machines strategically placed in subway stations. These machines use RFID technology to quickly process electronic tickets, reducing manual labor and improving overall system efficiency. The study reviews related work on RFID technology, discusses the proposed model, presents simulation and verification results, and provides a comprehensive analysis of the study. In addition, the study presents methodologies for the RFID encryption and security modeling, NFC device design and enhancement, and a comprehensive subway automatic ticket inspection system based on RFID devices. The systematic evaluation of RFID security performance highlights importance of optimizing authentication efficiency and reducing the number of invalid identifications of illegal tags. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves a higher recognition rate compared to traditional methods, suggesting its potential for improving subway ticket inspection systems.

articleTitle: Malpractice Detection in Examination Hall using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Various institutions administer tests at designated examination locations, chosen third-party and approved centers, and have established standards for installing CCTV cameras and conducting frisking under the supervision of designated personnel. Some institutions are using online proctoring, which enables students to take exams from any location. In all of the aforementioned scenarios, human monitoring is conducted, and maintaining a high level of vigilance may be challenging due to administrative oversight or intentional allowance of malpractice for personal gain. The malpractice detection may be attributed to acts like as plagiarism, unauthorized sharing of papers, and non-verbal communication. The study is conducted by capturing the dataset in the classroom of Christ University. The proposed approach is based on the YOLO framework. The movies are processed in real time to identify hand rotation, paper extraction, and classify the motion. The accuracy for the Head_right class is significantly higher than that of the Head_left class. The system is implemented using the programming language Python and has the potential for future expansion to provide real-time monitoring.

articleTitle: Designing A Concrete Kernel Computation Model For Chronic Kidney Disease Using Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Out of all non-communicable diseases, chronic kidney disease (CKD) accounts for 20% of all cases of morbidity and death worldwide. When the phases of the illness are identified accurately and promptly, the effects of chronic kidney disease (CKD) are thought to be mitigated. Hypertension, anemia, anomalies in the acid-base balance, poor nutritional status, difficulties of the metabolism of minerals and bone, and neurological problems are some of these impacts. Appropriate medication can be used to treat these conditions promptly. Machine learning approaches have been used in a number of studies on the early diagnosis of chronic kidney disease (CKD). It was not their primary goal to forecast the exact phases. For stage prediction, this study has used both binary and multiclassification. The kernel-based computation is employed as the prediction model. For prediction, feature removal by cross-validation and analysis of variance has been used. The CV was used to assess the model. The experiment's outcomes showed that the anticipated model outperforms SVM and DT and is based on cross-validation.

articleTitle: Linearity Performance and Distortion Characteristics of T and π – Gate AlGaN/GaN HEMT
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study examines the distortion and linearity characteristics of T and π-gated GaN-HEMTs. The investigation entails a comparative analysis of several figure-of-merits (FOM), including transconductance and output conductance (related to device efficiency), gate-source and gate-drain capacitances (pertaining to device impedance characteristics), drain current (reflecting device performance under operational conditions), as well as cutoff frequency (ft) and maximum frequency (fmax), which are pivotal parameters determining device bandwidth and operational limits. T – gate HEMT, due to improved gate-source capacitance and transconductance exhibits cut-off frequency of 23.8 GHz and maximum frequency of 53.1 GHz whereas π HEMT is found to offer superior gm’’, gm’’’, VIP3, IIP3, IMD3 and intrinsic gain. The high linearity and low distortion behavior is shown by π HEMT. Intrinsic gain of 16.8 dB has been obtained for π gate HEMT. The study also demonstrates that the utilization of low-K oxides leads to minor spikes in gm’’ and gm’’’, indicating the linear functionality of the device.

articleTitle: Diabetes prediction with the concept of AADE7 behavior using machine learning approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The human body, much like a machine, requires regular maintenance to function properly. However, due to certain detrimental habits, human body is susceptible to diseases such as diabetes, which can affect individuals from age 18 onward. Diabetes has numerous causes and effects, which can vary among healthcare professionals. The American Association of Diabetes Educators (AADE) has proposed seven self-care behaviors, collectively known as AADE7 for effective diabetes management. These guidelines not only offer preventive measures but also suggest ways to manage the disease if one is already affected. This research study analyzes the Indian Pima Diabetes dataset using Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Naive Bayes algorithms to predict diabetes. The outcomes of this approach are evaluated using a confusion matrix and other performance metrics.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Automated Food Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Food image classification is essential for numerous applications, like nutritional analysis, food recording, and dietary evaluation. The proliferation of social media and smartphones generated a significant increase in the sharing of food photographs online, necessitating automated systems capable of accurately classifying food items in images. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), particularly the MobileNetV2 architecture, have emerged as extremely strong machinery for identifying image tasks because of its capacity to extract unique characteristics directly from raw pixel data. This work focuses on utilizing CNNs and the MobileNetV2 architecture for deep learning-based automatic food image classification. MobileNetV2 strikes a balance between classification accuracy and processing efficiency, making it suitable for mobile and embedded vision applications. The study addresses important challenges in food image classification, including intra-class variances, cluttered backgrounds, and disparities in food appearance. The objective aims to set up a reliable and effective system which can determine food products in various visual scenarios by leveraging state-of-the-art deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Towards Sustainable Energy Solutions: Integrated Solar-Powered Battery Charging System Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research presents the design and implementation of a solar-powered battery charging system utilizing advanced hardware components including the SEPIC converter, PID controller, Arduino microcontroller, voltage sensor, and LCD display. The system aims to address the challenges associated with conventional solar charging systems by enhancing adaptability to varying solar conditions and optimizing the charging process. Through rigorous testing and analysis, the effectiveness of the integrated hardware components is evaluated, demonstrating promising outcomes in terms of efficiency, control, and user interface. The results affirm the viability of the proposed system as a reliable and efficient solution for off-grid battery charging applications.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy Segmented Images using ResNet50 and VGG16 Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), a severe complication arising from diabetes, make a significant threat to vision due to the deterioration of retinal blood vessels. This research work proposes a comprehensive methodology for the automated detection, grading, and segmentation of DR, leveraging advanced image processing , deep learning techniques and machine learning. The study utilizes the Indian Diabetic Retinopathy Image dataset (IDRID), comprising 81 fundus images and labels, to rigorously evaluates the proposed methodology. Key steps include detailed image preprocessing, VGG16-based feature extraction, Random Forest classifier-based grading, and innovative segmentation techniques for lesion localization. The evaluation demonstrates exceptional performance, with both VGG16 and ResNet50 architectures achieving over 99% accuracy. The process of semantic segmentation enhances interpretability, supporting clinical decision-making in retinopathy diagnosis. While the results are promising, future validation on diverse datasets and careful consideration of ethical implications are essential for responsible deployment in clinical settings. The proposed methodology signifies a significant step toward precise diagnostics and improved patient outcomes in diabetic retinopathy and holds potential for broader applications in retinal disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: Secured Voting System based on Multilayered Biometric Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The right to vote is a crucial aspect of a system that is democratic and allows people to select the leader or people they prefer. The traditional offline voting system is time-consuming, costly and requires lot of manpower, making it prevalent to frauds and human errors. There is a need to upgrade and develop efficient methods for voting ensuring system authenticity and voter verification. In the proposed work a multi-layered approach based voting system using biometric features is developed. The voter verification is performed using facial recognition, thumbprint and Aadhaar number validation. The use of unique biometric features and user details, strengthen voting system security and ensure authenticity while decreasing the chances of fraudulent activities during the voting process. A web application through three-step verification using biometric features and Aadhaar card is developed that facilitates a user-friendly and cost-effective voting environment under administrative guidance. Furthermore, this work creates a secured model by eliminating fraudulent or duplicate votes cast during elections and also displays user votes cast so they may be verified more efficiently for faster counting procedures allowing admin to release results more promptly.

articleTitle: IoT in Action: Design and Implementation of a Tank Water Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Water management in residential areas often faces challenges such as unpredictable shortages and damaging overflows due to inadequate monitoring of tank water levels. This study presents the design and implementation of an Internet of Things (IoT)-based tank water monitoring system aimed at providing a reliable and efficient solution to these issues. Utilizing advanced sensor technology, the system accurately monitors water levels, volume, and quality within storage tanks. It incorporates dual sensors that enhance reliability: one sensor manages the water level, initiating pump activation when levels fall below a critical threshold, while the second sensor prevents overflows by deactivating the pump once the water level reaches a pre-set maximum. The system is designed to be user-friendly, offering real-time water level data and control via an Android application or web dashboard. This allows for remote operation of the motor pump, ensuring that water availability is consistent and secure, while also safeguarding against overflows and subsequent water wastage. The implementation of this IoT system demonstrates significant potential for enhancing water resource management in residential settings, promoting both sustainability and ease of use.

articleTitle: Envision – An Object Detection System using Jetson Nano
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study proposes Envision, an innovative initiative designed to assist vision-impaired individuals using the Jetson Nano Developer Kit by integrating GPU technology for edge computing. By integrating a USB webcam and speaker with the Jetson Nano, Envision captures real-time video input and provides voice feedback, enhancing users' spatial awareness and accessibility. Key features include object identification, obstacle avoidance, facial recognition, text reading, and GPS-based navigation. Obstacle avoidance algorithms detect hazards, ensuring safe navigation, while facial recognition enhances social interactions by identifying known individuals. Text recognition enables reading from signs, documents, and displays, aiding in tasks like label and menu reading. GPS and mapping technologies offer directional and location-based assistance, and voice commands facilitate hands-free operation. Envision's customizable smart interface allows users to meet the system requirements, enhancing overall effectiveness. This comprehensive solution aims to significantly boost the confidence and independence of visually impaired individuals in their daily activities.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Workout Analysis Application for Posture Feedback and Repitition Grading
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The AI-powered exercise tracking system presented in this project represents a new approach to revolutionize fitness routines using cutting-edge technologies. Leveraging advanced computer vision techniques, particularly pose estimation, the system offers real-time tracking and analysis of exercise repetitions during gym workouts. Focused initially on four fundamental exercises like Bicep Curls, Push-Ups, Squats, and Shoulder Press. The proposed system employs Machine Learning (ML) models to detect and classify correct and incorrect exercise forms. Integrating the power of Mediapipe's pose detection framework and speech recognition capabilities, the proposed system provides accurate feedback and guidance to users through a smart web application interface. Through the selection of a tech stack including Python, OpenCV, Streamlit, and Scikit-Learn, the system ensures seamless data processing, model training, and user interaction. By analyzing workout videos uploaded by users, the proposed system identifies and highlights areas of improvement in exercise technique, enhancing the effectiveness and safety of fitness routines. Moreover, the integration of speech recognition enables hands-free control, adding convenience and accessibility for users during their workouts. This research study not only aims to optimize individual fitness journeys but also contributes to advancing the field of fitness tracking through the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and computer vision technologies. By empowering users with personalized feedback and guidance, the proposed system promotes healthier habits, improved performance, and overall well-being.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Integrating Advanced Conversational AI in Legal Summarization and Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research study explores the impact of advanced conversational AI, particularly LawGPT, on legal practice. Specializing in the Indian Penal Code (IPC) and integrated with the Legal Language Model (LLM), LawGPT offers precise interpretation of legal queries. By utilizing advanced pre-processing techniques, Dense Passage Retriever (DPR) for retrieval, and BART architecture for generation, LawGPT ensures contextually relevant responses. Through validation against human-generated responses, its efficacy and accuracy are affirmed, democratizing access to legal knowledge for professionals and laypersons. LawGPT's adoption promises to revolutionize legal research, enhancing efficiency and inclusivity in legal interactions. This study analyzes its widespread integration, recognizing its potential to shape a more accessible and efficient legal system, contributing to the ongoing research on exploring AI's role in legal practice.

articleTitle: Optimization Methodology for Cruise Ship Route Planning Integrating Sensor Networks and Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study presents an optimization methodology for cruise ship route planning that integrates sensor networks and communication systems. Cruise ship routes, which are critical to providing tourists with diverse experiences, require careful planning to ensure safety, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. This study reviews existing methodologies for cruise ship route planning, highlighting advances in optimization algorithms. The proposed methodology focuses on two key aspects: the ship sensor network and cruise ship-GPS communication. The study discusses the design considerations and mechanisms involved in these systems, emphasizing energy conservation, secure access, and efficient communication. In addition, the study introduces a novel optimization approach using neural networks for route planning to improve adaptability and efficiency. Simulation experiments validate the effectiveness of the methodology, demonstrating improved coverage, network lifetime, and energy efficiency in the node sleep scheduling mechanism test. In addition, the cruise ship route planning simulation demonstrates the system's ability to generate diverse routes and accurately simulate navigation processes.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Diagnosis using Deep Learning, Transfer Learning and Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Skin cancer is one of the most prevalent and popular forms of cancer worldwide, It have significant health risks if not detected and treated in early stages. It may look similar to normal skin disease in early stages which makes it very hard to detect and treat early. To diagnose skin cancer a medical professional needs to do a proper examination of the skin in order to establish whether or not the changes on the skin are likely to be caused by skin cancer. Further skin biopsy, removing a sample of suspicious skin for testing may be needed to confirm that diagnosis. In recent years, the advancement of models that use deep learning have shown encouraging results in automating the detection of skin cancer through the analysis of dermatoscopic images. This research work covers deep learning, transfer learning, and a hybrid transfer learning approach to solve this problem with better accuracy, recall and Precision rate which leads to promising results in detecting skin cancer in the early stage. The methodology involves the utilization of Convolution Neural Network, and pre-trained models ResNet152V2, VGG19 , MobileNetV3Large algorithms, and a hybrid transfer learning approach on the HAM10000 dataset, with a comparative evaluation based on performance metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, AUC etc. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficiency and dependability of deep learning models in the evaluation of skin cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring and Health Management of Aquatic Life with AquaTracker
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research work presents Aqua Tracker, an innovative software solution that integrates Internet of things (IoT) and deep learning methods to safeguard aquatic ecosystems. AquaTracker monitors important parameters such as pH level, hardness, dissolved oxygen, temperature, and fish health in real-time. Utilizing deep learning technology, it analyzes images to detect potential health issues in fish. Alerts are seamlessly communicated to users through a dedicated website and mobile application, simplifying proactive promotion of aquatic well-being and providing sustainable water management practices.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Credit Scoring and Credit Line Solution for the Unreserved and Self-Employed
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The financial industry's rapid evolution emphasizes the importance of accurate credit scoring, crucial for decision-making and timely access to loans. Challenges arise due to irregular income streams experienced by self-employed individuals, leading to uncertainty in demonstrating consistent repayment capacity to lenders. Self-employed individuals are often perceived as higher-risk borrowers due to income instability, resulting in stricter lending criteria, higher interest rates, or reduced loan amounts. Customer credit classes are based on default risk, with precise risk assessment vital for profitability. The proposed system employs a Random Forest Classifier Ensemble Learning model on a Two-wheeler Motorcycle Indian Dataset to enhance credit risk assessment comprehensively, especially for self-employed individuals. Credit line predictions incorporating ensemble learning on random forest are being utilized to provide loan amount estimations along with risk considerations, either by taking into account bank statements or other relevant financial data. The proposed system vouches to deliver an accurate result for those who seek aid from financial institutions. The proposed model achieves an accuracy of 87% and good MSE score of 25680.607346699337 by using the Random forest and Ensemble Learning model. The explainable AI graph serves as a valuable tool for transparency and understanding in AI systems, helping users trust and interpret the model's decisions more effectively.

articleTitle: Attendswift Hub:- An Advanced Attendance Monitoring System for Classrooms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: In a classroom comprising large number of students traditional attendance-taking methods, such as calling out names or passing around a sign-in sheet can become extremely time-consuming and inefficient. The large number of students makes it challenging for the instructor to manually record each student’s attendance in a timely manner. More over the process of checking attendance afterward becomes a challenging task. With a large number of students, the chances of errors in recording attendance manually increase significantly. This not only wastes valuable lecture time but also creates administrative headaches for the institution. An automated classroom attendance system designed to streamline the attendance-taking process by implementing a technologically advanced solution. The system operates by allowing teachers to effortlessly record attendance upon entering the classroom. Utilizing a user-friendly interface teachers can mark attendance on an hourly or periodic basis during each class session. The automation of this process not only reduces the time and effort traditionally spent on manual attendance tracking but also significantly minimizes the likelihood of errors.

articleTitle: Forecasting Cardio Vascular Diseases Using Kernel Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)

authors.preferredName: K N V P S Siva Nishanth
authors.firstName: K N V P S Siva

abstract: Cardiovascular disorders, including various heart diseases, have emerged as leading causes of mortality worldwide, necessitating accurate and effective diagnostic techniques. Leveraging data science approaches, particularly machine learning methods, offers a solution for analyzing large-scale medical datasets to enable early identification and proper care of these conditions. This study aims to utilize predictive modeling, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Naïve Bayes, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Random Forest, to analyze extensive medical records and datasets relevant to heart problems. The objective of this research study is to develop reliable prediction models that can enhance patient care and optimize healthcare processes by incorporating various characteristics such as age, gender, and biochemical markers. This study compares the effectiveness of Random Forest, KNN, Naïve Bayes, and SVM algorithms to determine the best method for estimating cardiac disease. Each algorithm's performance will be closely scrutinized to assess its ability to identify early indicators of cardiovascular diseases, ensuring that accuracy and other relevant evaluation metrics are carefully considered. The ultimate goal of this study is to equip medical professionals with advanced tools capable of quickly identifying and mitigating cardiovascular risks. This will not only improve patient outcomes but also alleviate the burden on healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Anti-Collision Speed Control System based on Embedded System using RFID
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Road accidents remain a significant global concern, often resulting from over speeding and human error. Implementing an effective collision avoidance system is crucial for enhanced road safety. This project proposes Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) technology combined with an embedded system to develop an anti-collision speed control system. Utilizing passive High-frequency Radio Frequency identification tags and an Arduino microcontroller, the system detects potential collisions and dynamically adjusts the speed of vehicles or robotic objects to prevent accidents. Specifically, industrial robots equipped with an embedded microcontroller and passive RFID tags can detect nearby robots and vehicles, allowing the system to modulate speed and navigate steep and sharp turns in mines safely. This capability extends to detecting turns and steep gradients in mining fields round the clock. The proposed system aims to enhance collision detection accuracy, improve response time and adaptability to changing environments.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient ECG Signal Processing based on Approximate Pruned Haar Discrete Wavelet Transform Implemented on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: One of the most commonly used instruments for the diagnosis and evaluation of epilepsy is the electroencephalogram (EEG). Currently, epilepsy be diagnosed mostly by a neurological specialist via visual or manual EEG examination readings. This study proposes an epilepsy computer-aided diagnostics (CAD) based on the Feed-Forward Neural Network (FFNN), Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT), and Shannon entropy. DWT divides EEG impulses into numerous sub-bands of frequency that consist of gamma, beta, alpha, theta, and delta. Shannon entropy extracts ECG information from every frequency sub-band. Lastly, FFNN uses the collected features to classify the related EEG signals as "normal" or "epileptic". The outcomes of experiment with the accessible to the public Bonn University EEG dataset indicate the total precision.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Summarization of Academic Literature using Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research study describes an innovative method for automated academic research article summarization that uses a transformer-based model in conjunction with natural language processing techniques. The proposed approach uses Named Entity Recognition, Latent Dirichlet Allocation for topic modelling, Term Frequency Analysis, Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency, and extraction of quantitatively significant sentences to identify critical features of a document. The summarization is based on an optimized Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer model that can provide short summaries that include important conclusions, techniques, and outcomes from research articles. This work not only contributes to the domain of automated text summarization but also has the potential to help researchers and academics quickly grasp knowledge from large research literature. The proposed model has achieved a F1 score of 93.5% for text summarization.

articleTitle: Enhancing Hybrid Filtering for Evolving Recommender Systems: Dealing with Data Sparsity and Cold Start Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The recommendation system has become common due to the widespread use of the Internet and the availability of a wide range of products. It serves as a useful tool in assisting decision-making on online purchases. Challenges in recommender system such as difficulties in starting a system from scratch, unavailability of important data, excessive focus on specific areas, lack of up-to-date information, scarcity of data, and incorrect metadata. The traditional recommendation system relies on the collaborative filtering algorithm. The most effective suggestion techniques are Collaborative Filtering and Content Based Filtering. Despite their popularity, these filtering systems still suffer from several limitations, including the Cold Start Problem, Sparsity, and Scalability, all of which result in subpar suggestions and to provide a recommendation-anticipation system based on a hybrid approach in this article. The suggested solution combines content-based filtering with collaborative filtering.This research established a model for an online shopping recommendation system that takes into account both people and products by analyzing two types of conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: Unveiling Malware Secrets Through Cutting-Edge Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Malware can covertly damage computers, steal data, and cause various other issues. It includes ransomware, worms, trojan horses, viruses, and botnets, each with different motives and impacts. Malware can compromise private data, slow down or crash systems, and even demand ransom. To combat these threats, advanced security tools that detect ransomware through network traffic monitoring and behavior analysis are essential. This study proposes a multi-layered approach for malware detection, including the use of robust antivirus programs, rigorous anti-malware scans, and regular software updates. Effective malware analysis involves static and dynamic analysis, malware segregation in controlled environments, and signature creation. By reverse engineering the malware code, network monitoring and memory activities, and generating comprehensive reports with indicators of compromise, a deeper understanding of malware behavior and mitigation strategies can be achieved. This research study aims to enhance malware detection and evaluation by using machine learning techniques. The objective of this research study is to develop reliable models for thorough examination and real-time malware detection, thereby promoting proactive cybersecurity measures.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Consumer Price Index using SARIMAX Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) is a vital economic indicator for measuring inflation and price changes in India. Accurate forecasting of the All-India CPI is crucial for informed decision-making and policy formulation. This study employs the SARIMAX (Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Variables) modelling approach to forecast the All-India CPI, focusing specifically on the "Cereals and Products" category. The methodology involves data collection, preprocessing, identification of time series components, checking stationarity, transforming non-stationary data, model building, evaluation, and deployment. The SARIMAX model incorporates seasonal variations, autoregressive components, and exogenous factors to capture the complex dynamics of the Indian economy. The study reveals the efficacy of SARIMAX modelling in accurately forecasting the CPI for the "Cereals and Products" category in comparison with ARIMA, Support Vector, Random Forest (RF), Holt-Winters and Exponential Smoothing models. The findings have practical implications for policymakers, economists, and stakeholders in India, aiding in formulating targeted monetary policies, setting inflation targets, and making strategic decisions related to the cereal sector.

Author Keywords: SARIMAX (Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Variables) modelling

articleTitle: Enhancing Access Control: A Biometric Approach with Facial Recognition and Near-Field Communication Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study presents a human identity authentication framework that integrates facial recognition and biometric scanning, enhancing security and speeding up individual identification. The system also includes careful observation of people entering and leaving a designated area, keeping detailed logs in a MongoDB back-end. This strategic integration allows for effective tracking and retrieval of vital information about movement patterns within the monitored area. TensorFlow models, which use Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN), are the core of the identification process, contributing to unmatched accuracy in person recognition. This study provides a comprehensive investigation of the cooperative combination of bio-metrics, facial recognition, CNN, and backend database management for identity verification, raising the bar for their effectiveness, security, and user-friendliness in today’s technological environments. The CNN based algorithm was opted for making facial recognition a much more accurate and easier process.

articleTitle: Psychological activity data classification based on micro-expression recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Real-time classification of psychological activity is crucial for various applications, and micro-expression recognition has emerged as a promising approach. In this study, an innovative approach is presented to classify psychological activity data using micro-expression recognition. The study first reviews the theoretical foundations of face recognition and then details the proposed algorithm, focusing on feature extraction using the Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) method. This study also introduces a novel enhancement method called the cutout module to increase data diversity and improve network generalization. In addition, the study uses the Ghost module to optimize feature processing and proposes a centroid-based upsampling algorithm to handle unbalanced data. Experimental results on the Fer2013 dataset demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach, achieving improved recognition accuracy. This study highlights the potential of micro-expression recognition for psychological activity classification.

articleTitle: Optimizing EEG Artifact Removal in Motor Imagery BCI: Integrating FCIF, FCFBCSP, and Modified DNN for Enhanced Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interfaces (MIBCIs) have revolutionized human-computer interaction by giving consumers authority over devices through mental movements. However, EEG signals crucial for decoding imagined movements often suffer from artifacts, challenging the accuracy of MI decoding. This study presents an innovative EEG artifact removal technique tailored for MI BCIs, synergizing Four Class Iterative Filtering (FCIF), Four Class Filter Bank Common Spatial Patterns (FCFBCSP), and a Modified Deep Neural Network (DNN) with Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), Power Spectral Density (PSD), and Spectral Coherence (SC) evaluation. By enhancing specificity in feature extraction and accommodating four MI classes, this approach aims to enhance the reliability and accuracy of MI BCIs.

Author Keywords: FCFBCSP:Four Class Filterbank Common Spatial Pattern

articleTitle: Optimizing Recommendation Systems : A Hybrid Approach for Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This recommender system model aims to develop a hybrid recommender system in Python to tackle the "cold start problem" prevalent in traditional recommender systems. Beginning with the aspiration to enhance the root mean squared error (RMSE) of existing recommendation algorithms, the project embarks on a comprehensive journey of data exploration, wrangling, and visualization. The dataset is scrutinized for missing or erroneous entries, necessitating advanced techniques such as value imputations with KNN for data restoration. Delving deeper, the project explores the creation of engineered features to enrich the training dataset. Leveraging a diverse array of machine learning algorithms, including content-based and collaborative filtering approaches, multiple models are constructed and evaluated for their efficacy in recommending items to users. Through iterative refinement and re-training on the augmented dataset, the project iterates towards the development of an improved hybrid recommender system. Ultimately, the system is assessed for its predictive accuracy, thereby enriching their online experiences.

articleTitle: Catalyzing Domestic Waste Management: A Deep Learning and IoT Enabled Smart Bin
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: India, with a population of 144 crores, undergoes a great challenge in waste management, producing approximately 62 million tons of waste each year. The current waste management practices in India heavily depends on manual labor, leading to unsanitary and unhygienic conditions.. The manual segregation of waste, particularly on a large scale, is a challenging task for workers. In this research work, an innovative solution to tackle the enduring challenges of waste management in India, where labor-intensive manual practices persist is presented. , This exploration fills the gap by developing a novel prototype that efficiently categorizes waste into biodegradable and non-biodegradable types. The system provides an accuracy of 95% within few seconds. By utilizing advanced technologies, the study aims to overcome the limitations of manual segregation, offering a cleaner and more sustainable waste management system for India.

articleTitle: Multimodal Emotion Analysis for Depression Detection- Integrating Facial Expression and Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study aims to revolutionize early depression detection by utilizing emotion recognition technology with an accuracy of 77.92%. Through the seamless integration of real-time facial expression detection powered by OpenCV and Haar cascade classifiers, along with advanced speech analysis facilitated by the librosa package, the proposed multimodal system offers a comprehensive solution. By encompassing emotions ranging from neutral to surprised, this innovative fusion provides psychologists with a tool for more accurate depression assessments. Representing a significant leap forward in mental health care, the study offers a proactive approach to identifying and monitoring depression.

articleTitle: A Review: Complete Analysis of the Cache Architecture for Better Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Cache memory has a significant role in the any computer device, it has an impact on performance of system. Furthermore, the latest computer devices are well designed to run any kind of applications smoothly and memory protractive. So many personal computers are taken leverage of controlling and interfering system in terms of improvement. As it is aware that without memory, the device cannot perform any tasks, similarly cache memory plays vital role in any memory hierarchy system. Since the speed of the computer processor and memory is drastically increasing, there is also a crisis to increase the speed of cache memory. Cache memory is a high-speed and small-sized type of volatile computer memory which serves as a bridge between the computer's main memory and the central processing unit. It is designed to store frequently accessed data and instructions, improving overall system performance by reducing the time it takes for the CPU (Central Processing Unit) to access this information. This study firstly reviews the proposed architectures with the improved techniques and secondly, the study focuses on the cache memory mechanism and optimizing configuration of cache to smooth running an application and for better performance and finally compares the cases in terms of speed, performance and scalability of cache memory to the main memory.

articleTitle: Predicting Protein-Ligand Binding Affinities: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Molecular docking plays a vital role in drug development and molecular modeling, with the accuracy of docking heavily reliant on the scoring function's reliability. Scoring functions assess ligand positions, predict binding modes and affinities, and identify potential drug leads for specific protein targets. Traditional scoring functions, such as force field-based or empirical methods, often have limitations in accuracy. To address this, machine learning (ML) methods are employed in the proposed model to enhance the prediction accuracy. ML scoring functions integrate various physicochemical and geometric properties of protein-ligand complexes, outperforming traditional methods. This research study aims to improve prediction accuracy by comparing ML scoring functions with traditional ones. This study evaluates ML algorithms like SVM, RF, and CNN, comparing their performance with traditional scoring functions. Scoring accuracies are assessed using benchmark datasets (2007 and 2010 PDBbind), demonstrating that the best-performing ML-based scoring function exhibits superior binding affinity compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Transforming Healthcare: Unified Medical Identification and AI-Enabled Treatment Advancements
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: In the dynamic realm of healthcare, accurate disease prediction stands as a cornerstone for proactive management and personalized care. Through the introduction of Unified Medical Identification (UMI), users can easily connect to their medical records anywhere at any time. With advanced features like rural language support via video-based disease prediction integrated with the Large Language Model, the system generates a broader bracket of users. An ensembled machine learning model is used for general disease prediction. Integrating the CatBoost Classifier with the LangChain framework, the model accurately detects chronic diseases keeping UMI as the central source of the user’s medical data. Furthermore, an AI chatbot aids in the enhancement of user engagement offering targeted treatment options and suitable lifestyle recommendations resulting in better health outcomes. With a remarkable 92.8% accuracy in general disease prediction and a whopping 95.8% accuracy in chronic disease prediction, this revolutionary tool not only reforms the healthcare delivery mode but also guarantees that it is well accepted and widely available across dissimilar communities.

articleTitle: Diffusion Inference with Dynamic Classifier-free Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The introduction of the diffusion architecture has led to rapid progress in image generation. These models learn to iteratively generate images by predicting noise from an initial Gaussian distribution, which is learnt through forward and reverse diffusion. The process of iterative sampling occurs over a number of inference steps. Classifier guidance is a popular technique that guides the generation process of latent diffusion models (LDMs). It does this by adding an external classifier into the training process. This however requires additional training and severely limits the diversity of the synthesized data along with several other limitations. To improve on this, a novel approach, known as Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), was introduced that removed the need for a separate classifier. It controls the sample generation process using a parameter known as the CFG scale. Previously, this scale has been set to a constant value during inference. This research work proposes varying the CFG scale values across the inference steps by making use of various scheduling functions, which not only results in better images but also unlocks the full potential of the rich latent space representation of diffusion models by allowing for the sampling of various different images from the same initial conditions by only varying the CFG scale and keeping all other parameters constant.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection using EEG Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Brain tumors present a significant health challenge, demanding early and accurate diagnostic methods. This study utilizes the EEG wave patterns for non-invasive brain tumor detection. This research study aims to analyze EEG data using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to identify the tumor-related wave patterns. The proposed methodology involves preprocessing EEG signals, extracting relevant features, and training both CNN and SVM models to classify normal and tumor-related EEG patterns. The interpretability techniques are also incorporated to interpret the neural signs contributing to tumor detection. This enhances the proposed model's transparency and establishes a connection between detected patterns and clinically relevant information. While recognizing the challenges such as data variability and the necessity for large, well-annotated datasets, this study highlights the potential of EEG-based detection method

articleTitle: Multimodal Image Fusion for Enhanced Brain Tumor Detection using Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The use of machine learning techniques to improve the diagnosis of brain tumours has gained popularity in recent years. In particular, multimodal image fusion has emerged as a promising approach to combining information from multiple imaging modalities, such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and positron emission tomography (PET), to improve diagnostic accuracy. This research uses machine learning algorithms to present a unique multimodal image fusion method for increased brain tumour detection. The proposed method starts by preprocessing the input images, including noise reduction and image registration. Then, feature extraction is performed to extract relevant information from each modality. After that, a fusion algorithm is utilised to create a single fused image by combining the features that were derived from several modalities. Finally, a machine learning classifier is trained on the fused image to perform brain tumour classification. The proposed method holds great potential in clinical practice, providing valuable support to radiologists and assisting in the accurate diagnosis of brain tumours. Multimodal image fusion, brain tumour detection, machine learning, and advanced techniques

articleTitle: Multitask Sentiment Analysis Integrated Machine Learning Framework to Classify Informative Tweets From Multidomains
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research addresses the increasing need to analyze user tweets across diverse domains, particularly during crises such as COVID-19 pandemic, where informative tweets play a crucial role in disaster management. Existing methods for capturing and clustering informative tweets often overlook user sentiment, resulting in classification inaccuracies and computational inefficiencies. To address these challenges, a multitask sentiment analysis integrated machine learning framework is proposed. The proposed framework incorporates data preprocessing techniques including stop word removal, stemming, and tokenization, followed by TF-IDF scoring to identify and filter relevant tweets. Integrating BERT for sentiment extraction, the proposed framework utilizes a multitask approach integrating Support Vector Machines (SVMs) and Naive Bayes classifiers to classify and rank informative tweets based on sentiment semantics and syntactic distances. Experimental evaluation on a Twitter dataset demonstrates the superiority of the proposed model over traditional approaches in terms of precision, recall, and f-measure, offering a robust solution for real-time disaster management through Twitter analytics.

articleTitle: Investigation of Student Engagement Monitoring System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research study aims to enhance the intelligent classroom ecosystem by integrating the Local Binary Pattern Histogram (LBPH) algorithm with human expertise to identify students' faces. Monitoring student attentiveness is crucial for effective learning. To support this, this study uses Mediapipe to analyze students' body posture, providing insights into their engagement levels. Additionally, the proposed framework includes the Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) Algorithm to detect signs of drowsiness and yawning. By continually refining the proposed framework, this study intends to improve intelligent classroom ecosystems, helping educators to create environments that increase student success.

articleTitle: Forecasting Heart Disease Risk using Machine Learning and Regularized Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Heart disease (HD) is one of the argues of death among people throughout the world. Estimation of HD occurrence and its risk analysis are crucial challenges in the medical field. Early recognition of HD incidence risk helps people to improve their existence rates through attending early and better treatments. In this connection, Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) methods play an effective role in health records handling and estimating of health abnormal cases at a primary stage. In this work, ML and DL strategies are operated for analysis of basic health parameters which are helpful to examine and forecast HD risk.
