The performance of Decision Tree, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and Regularized Artificial Neural Network (ANN-R and ANN-DR) classifiers are evaluated based on metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The performance analysis report reveals that the ANN-DR technique outperformed and forecasted heart risk with 99% accuracy.

articleTitle: Exploring Advanced Techniques for Security Testing of Sensor Device Chips
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study explores advanced techniques for security testing of sensor device chips, critical components in embedded systems and the Internet of Things (IoT). The study emphasizes comprehensive considerations including power management, communication protocol compatibility, and software/hardware interface stability. A review of existing literature highlights significant contributions to improving chip security, multi-factor authentication, data encryption, and intelligent security mechanisms. The proposed methodology focuses on improving hardware security, implementing multi-factor authentication, data encryption, and integrating intelligent security mechanisms for future sensor device chips. Detailed test procedures for sensor device chips are presented, including light source testing, position sensor chip testing, and monitoring system testing. The results contribute to the ongoing development of secure and efficient sensor device chips that are essential for various IoT applications.

articleTitle: A Deep Automated System for Detection of Fake Currency
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Generating fake currency becomes more complicated for the country's economy. This shows a significant impact on economic growth and harm to national security. Many existing models are available to find fake currency by using machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms. The existing models have several issues detecting fake currency, such as more processing time, highly expensive, and mismatched results. The proposed approach is called the automated approach (AA), which finds the accurate fake currency. In this study, the proposed automated approach combines RESNET50 for training and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to detect and locate fake currency effectively. The training RESNET50 collects the fake currency images and obtains the patterns and factors showing the difference between original and fake currency. The preprocessing technique of Bilateral Filtering is used to denoise the image without losing the edges of the photos. The Grayscale Conversion (GC) model is used as the feature extraction technique, which shows the significant impact on the final output. The proposed GAN model shows high performance in detecting fake currency. Results show that the automated approach performed better in detecting and classifying fake currency.

articleTitle: Human Computer Interaction on Children based on AI
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent, understanding Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) is crucial, especially from the perspective of children who increasingly encounter AI through smart toys, educational apps, and virtual assistants. This study analyses the impact of AI on children's social, emotional, and cognitive development, as well as privacy and security concerns. Using a comprehensive research methodology that includes surveys, interviews, and observations, data is collected from children of various backgrounds and age groups, with input from their parents or guardians. The analysis employs established HCI frameworks to focus on user experience, usability, and user-centred design. This research study aims to inform the design and development of child-friendly AI technology by closely examining how children interact with AI systems. The findings will enhance the existing body of knowledge on HCI, AI, and children, laying the groundwork for ethical and intentional design in AI-enhanced interactions for young users. This study contributes to creating a secure and supportive technological environment for children's growth and development.

articleTitle: Integration of NLP and Deep Learning for Automated Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: In today’s digital era, the widespread issue of fake news significantly undermines the credibility of information, highlighting the need for sophisticated detection methods. This study explores into the use of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Deep Learning to automate the identification of fake news. The study evaluates several neural network architectures, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTM), Bidirectional LSTM, Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), and a combined CNN+Bidirectional LSTM model. Our extensive testing revealed that the hybrid CNN+Bidirectional LSTM model stands out, achieving an impressive accuracy of 98.13%. This model effectively merges the convolutional layers that extract features with bidirectional LSTM layers that capture temporal dependencies, thus improving its ability to detect subtle textual indications of fake news. The study advances the field of fake news detection by empirically demonstrating the superior performance of specific model combinations, offering crucial insights for developing more robust and precise systems to tackle the ongoing issue of misinformation on digital platforms.

articleTitle: YOLO based Object Detection Techniques for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Safe navigation in autonomous vehicles (AVs) demands a robust perception system capable of real-time object detection. This study explores the application of deep learning, specifically You Only Look Once (YOLO) methods, to achieve this critical functionality. The research study investigates various YOLO architectures, balancing the trade-off between speed and accuracy essential for real-time AV operation. The research work tackles object detection, encompassing not only general object recognition (using publicly available COCO and KITTI datasets) but also lane marking and traffic sign detection (leveraging a custom dataset). The research addresses the challenges posed by dynamic environments, varying lighting conditions, and small object identification. Techniques like data augmentation are explored to improve the robustness of the models. Furthermore, the potential for multi-sensor fusion is considered as a means to enhance perception capabilities. This project demonstrates the effectiveness of YOLO-based deep learning for real-time multitask object detection in AVs.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Charger System Design Enabling V2G and G2V Energy Transfer
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The surge in electric vehicle (EV) production reflects a global shift towards sustainable transportation, driven by environmental concerns and advancements in battery technology. The rise of bidirectional EV charging systems further amplifies this momentum, allowing for two-way energy transfer between EVs and the grid. This research work explores the significance and technical complexities of bidirectional charging, emphasizing its role in enhancing grid resilience and integrating renewable energy sources. Through a comprehensive analysis of charging station configurations, control systems, and charger topologies, the study underscores the transformative potential of bidirectional charging for sustainable mobility. Simulation results demonstrate the productiveness of bidirectional controllers in facilitating vehicle-to-grid (V2G) and grid-to-vehicle (G2V) energy transfer. As electric vehicles continue to grow rapidly, bidirectional charging systems balanced to revolutionize energy management, paving the way for a greener and more efficient transportation ecosystem.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling in Forex Trading: A Time Series Analysis Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research explores the application of predictive modeling for time series analysis in the context of Foreign Exchange (FOREX) trading, focusing specifically on the USD, EUR, and GBP currency pairs against BDT. The study endeavors to develop a neural network model for accurate exchange rate predictions, aiming to address the challenges posed by uncertainties inherent in the FOREX market. By utilizing a dataset spanning 15 years with 11,745 data points, the research employs feature engineering techniques, including min-max normalization, to enhance model performance. Various machine learning algorithms such as Support Vector Regression, Random Forest Regressor, Decision Tree Regressor, K-neighbors Regressor, SGD Regressor, and XGBRegressor, as well as deep learning algorithms including Convolutional Neural Network, Long Short-Term Memory, Bidirectional LSTM, and several hybrid models, are explored in predicting closing prices for selected currency pairs. The study reveals the effectiveness of these models, with the Random Forest Regressor and bidirectional LSTM standing out among the respective categories.

articleTitle: Defending the Digital World: A Comprehensive Guide Against SQL Injection Threats
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: An SQL injection attack is one type of cyberattack targeting web application databases to gain data or modify the structure of data, such as insert, delete, or update. Every sector that utilizes the website as a mode of business uses various techniques to avoid cyber-attacks, but attacks still occur day by day, and it is challenging to use this powerful tool to minimize attacks. Technology is multiplying quickly and new attacks are invented, so we should update and think ahead on how to make the system powerful before a chance attack occurs. There must be a minimum probability of hackers hacking the system This research work briefly discuss on SQL attacks in various phase what is SQL injection, how it happens, mechanisms and effects, and how to protect your data through various prevention and detection mechanisms.

articleTitle: Trip Craft: Personalized Travel Recommendation Bot
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The Travel Recommendation Bot is a specialized solution devised to help users in crafting their travel plans, particularly for destinations and attractions within Kerala, India. By considering user inputs such as origin, duration of stay, and preferred types of attractions and destinations, the bot generates tailored recommendations aimed at enhancing the overall travel experience. Key functionalities of the chatbot include computing travel distances and time with the help of Open-Source Routing Machine (OSRM) API, finding an efficient travel method and employing a dual approach to suggest nearby attractions and recommend destinations based on user preferences. It Leverages a curated dataset and employs the K-Nearest-Neighbor (KNN) algorithm to recommend destinations based on user preferences. The chatbot employs the Rapid Automatic Keyword Extraction Algorithm (RAKE) for Intent Recognition to interpret user queries and deliver personalized suggestions. Through the integration of Natural Language Processing (NLP) algorithms and the travel-related dataset, the chatbot serves as an effective virtual travel assistant, empowering users to plan their trips efficiently and elevate their travel experiences.

articleTitle: DeepSVM-A Novel Approach for Early Detection and Classification of IoT Botnet Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Though there are few security mechanisms developed to detect the IoT botnet attack, they are mostly rule based classifiers, which are formal rule-based detection that could be circumvented by the malware attacker’s knowledge. This research study deals with the problem of overcoming the issue of determining patterns from the voluminous IoT dataset and predicting the attacks and normal packets in presence of class imbalance. To enhance the accuracy rate of IoT botnet attack detection by developing a deep learning paradigm to discover the pattern of malicious packets before they penetrate the host network. To address the overfitting issue that arises during the training phase of a deep neural network, the proposed model called Deep Neural Support Vector empowered with Butterfly Optimization Algorithm (Deep-SVM+BOA) replaces Support Vectors to identify the pattern of incoming data and categorize it as malicious or benign packets. To determine if a message is anomalous or not, it makes use of the attention mechanism and the fully connected layer network. Instead of using SoftMax, Support vector machine is used in this proposed work to perform classification and the hyperparameters values are scrutinized by the food searching behavior of the Butterfly Optimization Algorithm. The simulation results proved the efficiency of the proposed Deep-SVM+BOA compared with other three models using three different evaluation criteria to detect the IoT botnet attack on a UNSW-NB15 dataset.

articleTitle: Pothole Detection and Road Damage Assessment System Utilizing Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Road infrastructure degradation remains a significant challenge, prompting the utilization of cutting-edge image processing techniques to enhance infrastructure management and road safety. While traditional pothole patching methods are time-consuming, this research study focuses on three key aspects of road maintenance: assessing the prevalence of potholes, evaluating their impact on road conditions, and alerting drivers to nearby potholes to mitigate risks. To differentiate from approaches that merely detect and count potholes, the proposed methodology incorporates segmentation techniques to precisely quantify areas impacted by potholes. This involves utilizing the capabilities of a YOLOv8 model trained on custom real-time image datasets. The YOLOv8 model stands out for its user-friendly interface, simplicity, and effectiveness, as highlighted in this research. Moreover, this study introduces a novel route selection method based on the severity of road damage and pothole presence. The main aim of this study is to substantially enhance road safety, refine maintenance practices, and reinforce the resilience of urban environments through these innovative solutions.

articleTitle: Emotion Classification using Artificial Neural Networks and Haar Cascade
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research work proposes a real-time emotion recognition system utilizing Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Haar cascades for facial feature detection. Initially Lumed-2 dataset is used for training and modeling. Emotion recognition plays a pivotal role in human-computer interaction, affective computing, and various other domains. The system aims to accurately detect and classify facial expressions in real-time, allowing for seamless integration into interactive applications and systems. The methodology involves preprocessing facial images to extract relevant features using Haar cascades, followed by providing these features into an ANN architecture for emotion classification. The ANN is trained on a dataset of labeled facial expressions, employing epochs to iteratively refine the model's parameters and enhance its accuracy. Through rigorous experimentation and validation, the system's performance is evaluated, measuring its ability to accurately recognize a diverse range of human emotions in real-time scenarios. The project's significance lies in its potential applications across numerous fields, including human-computer interaction, virtual reality, healthcare, and marketing. Results demonstrate promising accuracy rates, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed approach in real-time emotion recognition tasks

articleTitle: CDSS based Mobile Application for Stroke Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Stroke, the world’s second leading cause of mortality, presents a significant global health challenge, with approximately 15 million new cases annually resulting in 5 million deaths and long-term disabilities. This burden underscores the critical need for innovative interventions. In response, a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) mobile application is being developed to revolutionize stroke care. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset incorporating key parameters such as Age, BMI, Gender, Heart Disease, and Smoking Status, predictive models have been constructed to anticipate stroke occurrences. Employing multiclass classification for stroke severity (class 0, 1, 2, 3), various machine learning techniques, including Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF) Classification, and Naive Bayes, were employed to develop and train three distinct models for accurate prediction. Among these algorithms, Random Forest demonstrated the highest performance, achieving an accuracy rate of approximately 89%. The CDSS empowers healthcare professionals by providing them with decision-making tools that enable more accurate and timely interventions. By integrating patient data and evidence-based guidelines, the CDSS assists physicians in delivering personalized and optimized care plans tailored to each patient’s unique needs. Focused on assessing stroke severity, implementing evidence-based protocols, and delivering personalized patient care, the app offers real-time access to crucial information and diagnostic support.

articleTitle: Application and Optimization of Robot Systems in Industrial Production Line
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study focuses on the application and optimization of robotic systems in industrial production lines, with the overall goal of increasing manufacturing efficiency and streamlining process automation. A pioneering vision-based methodology for industrial robot sensing is presented, which enables precise control mechanisms through improved environmental data acquisition. In addition, a comprehensive methodology is presented for optimizing robot control at the physical level, thereby improving overall system efficiency and performance. By combining insights from an exhaustive review of related literature with innovative methodologies, this study makes a significant contribution to advancing the integration of robotic systems in industrial production lines. The experimental platform established for the visual target recognition and grasping system of industrial robots has undergone rigorous testing involving various objects commonly encountered in industrial environments. The results showed remarkable success rates in grasping various objects, with certain objects achieving perfect success rates of 100% over multiple trials. In particular, the bottle and small box showed exceptional performance, with a perfect success rate across all trials. Conversely, some objects had comparatively lower success rates due to factors such as shape complexity or surface texture. These empirical results highlights the effectiveness of proposed methods in facilitating reliable object recognition and gripping in industrial production lines.

articleTitle: Smart ICU Patient Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: To monitor comatose patients, a suggested system includes wearable sensors such as temperature, IR sensors, accelerometer, heartbeat, SPO2 oximeter, and flex sensors. Predictions about the chance of recovery are made possible by data kept on a Cloud server that is accessible from a PC or smartphone. This takes care of hospital monitoring issues and guarantees prompt interventions. Furthermore, by remotely monitoring levels and instantly stopping the flow when the bottle is empty, a saline level monitoring system improves patient safety during therapy and guards against injury brought on by carelessness or hectic schedules. Sensor technology advancements help speedy patient recovery and better healthcare in the face of an expanding world population.

articleTitle: Enhanced Feature Extraction for Image Dehazing: A Comparative Study between Deep Learning Architectures and FFA-NET
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The problem of poor visibility in foggy images has spurred various image de-hazing strategies. As the need for high-quality images grows, especially for autonomous systems, this research aims to leverage different Deep Learning (DL) architectures to draw out key details from images , localizing this retrieved data to mitigate the impact of haze. The work explores using DL methods, particularly contrasting the regression and classification models of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), to remove haze from foggy images. This work sets the stage for further developments in image processing, particularly in conditions with poor visibility. It opens opportunities for improving image quality in various applications, such as autonomous driving and outdoor robotics, where clarity of vision is crucial. The final stage of the proposed model involves three specific pre-processing methods: contextual regularization, air light estimation and boundary constraint for optimal results. The next stage sets out to determine the best DL model for producing clear images from de-hazed ones.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal data analysis of Internet of Vehicles: from scene information collection to remote analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research focuses on spatio-temporal data analysis in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV), covering the comprehensive journey from scene information collection to remote analysis. The study begins by elucidating the key layers within the IoV architecture, highlighting the perceptual layer responsible for real-time sensing, the network layer for data processing and transmission, and the application layer that facilitates user interaction. The collection of scene information is crucial for autonomous driving, but it faces challenges such as sensor field limitations. To address this, the study proposes an improved AdaBoost algorithm for road scene recognition, which enhances the model's ability to process unbalanced data. Subsequently, the research explores spatio-temporal data analysis in IoV communication, focusing on cellular network communication (C-V2X) and dedicated short-range wireless communication (DSRC). An edge computing model is introduced to reduce latency and energy consumption by optimizing task scheduling and resource management. Experimental verification validates the efficacy of the proposed methods, demonstrating superior performance compared to traditional algorithms. The results highlight the importance of spatio-temporal data analysis in enhancing IoV capabilities and provide valuable insights for future research and development in intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: Fashion Forecasting: Insights into the Latest Advances in Fashion Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Fashion is an ever-evolving industry and plays a significant role in our routine lives. Nowadays, everyone wants to look fashionable in their outfits. The way one dress is not only a reflection of our personalities but is also influenced by various factors, including our skin tone, the occasion at hand, and the prevailing weather conditions. Selecting an outfit that takes into consideration factors like skin tone, occasion, and weather can be a challenging and overwhelming process. Traditional recommendation systems consider the user’s preferences and wardrobe, regardless of color matching, weather, and occasion. The suggested techniques use different types of recommendation algorithms that are categorized according to the algorithm. Besides the system, a combination of virtual try-on to choose from instantly and virtually try the clothes by the users which helps them to decide and choose one or many of the recommended clothes. Virtual try-on helps the users to try the recommended clothes. Evaluation encompasses metrics such as Precision, Recall, and Accuracy, revealing high performance in style and outfit color classification, with accuracies of 93.28% and 91.75%, respectively. This survey analyzes and investigates different algorithms and approaches to fashion recommendation involving comparative study and provides a comprehensive survey of existing outfit recommendation systems, their methodologies, data sources, evaluation metrics, and limitations.

articleTitle: LiDAR and BIM Integration for 3D Reconstruction and Preservation of Cultural Heritage Images in Ancient Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study presents an innovative methodology for integrating LiDAR and Building Information Modeling (BIM) to reconstruct and preserve images of cultural heritage in ancient architecture. Leveraging advances in deep learning and computer vision, the research study proposes a comprehensive approach to improve the fidelity and authenticity of reconstructed three-dimensional scenes. The methodology includes LiDAR remote sensing image collection using UAVs, a novel deep learning-based 3D image reconstruction algorithm, and the integration of BIM for visualization and preservation. Experimental evaluation of the proposed methodology demonstrates competitive performance compared to existing methods. Specifically, the Chamfer Distance (CD) metric is used as a standard for evaluation and shows that the proposed approach achieves a median CD value of 0.531, indicating stable and reliable reconstruction results. This research contributes to the advancement of 3D reconstruction techniques for heritage preservation and provides a foundation for future research in this area.

articleTitle: Integrating Emotion Detection with Sentiment Analysis for Enhanced Text Interpretation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The analysis of public sentiment on various social media platforms has become more important.. However, conventional sentiment analysis often struggle to capture intricate emotional nuances present in textual data.. This study proposes an innovative approach by integrating emotion detection with sentiment analysis to improve the interpretation of text.. A novel algorithm "BERT-DeepEmo" is proposed, combining the strong contextual modeling capabilities of Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) with a deep learning-based emotion recognition model (DeepEmo). Simulation analyses were performed to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm compared to established approaches like BiLSTM-ECNN and RoBERTa-EDTA. Evaluation metrics including accuracy, precision, and mean absolute error were employed for comparison purposes. The results confirmed that BERT-DeepEmo enhances the overall quality of sentiment analysis while considering the emotional nuances in text. These findings highlight the proposed approach's potential to offer a more holistic and effective sentiment analysis framework, thereby facilitating informed decision-making and deeper insights across various applications. Future research work may explore into further integration with alternate process of emotional data, such as speech or visual inputs, to broaden the framework's applicability and efficacy.

articleTitle: Medico Bot: AI based Telemedicine System with Disease Diagnosis and Expert Recommendation System with Blockchain Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study describes the creation and deployment of a state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence system intended for online healthcare delivery. The system can be accessed via a website using desktop browsers or specialized kiosks. Based on user input, the system provides users with succinct descriptions and cures for diseases by integrating a prediction model, which is optimized using a reinforcement learning optimizer. Moreover, it enables user-specialist doctor interactions through telemedicine advice sessions and streamlines online healthcare experiences by integrating a hybrid content-based filtering recommendation system. A secure biometric identification system using fingerprint or iris readings ensures user verification and access to medical records. Moreover, the system makes it possible to retrieve electronic prescriptions written by on-site doctors, giving consumers the option to print or buy medications directly from the pharmacists. The system stores e-prescription records on the Ethereum blockchain, allowing for future validation and reference, in order to guarantee data confidentiality and integrity. By combining cutting-edge prediction and recommendation algorithms with improved accessibility, efficiency, and data security, this research advances online healthcare delivery systems.

articleTitle: Exploring the Frontiers of Blockchain and Web Technologies for a Dynamic Digital Future
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The combination of blockchain and web technology leads to a new era of digital ecosystems, with disruptive potential across several industries. This research study investigates the deep link between blockchain and web technologies, focusing on major ideas such as Web 3.0, decentralization, and smart contracts. The study's extensive literature assessment indicates the enormous impact of this integration, which extends beyond traditional fields such as healthcare and finance. Smart contracts, in particular, have emerged as powerful instruments for optimizing digital contracts and increasing transaction efficiency. Furthermore, Web 3.0's decentralization and empowerment aspects play an important role in strengthening digital systems. The report also discusses issues with blockchain- web integration and makes solutions for a more inventive, transparent, and secure digital future.

articleTitle: Scalable Web Data Extraction for Xtree Analysis: Algorithms and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)

authors.preferredName: N S Koti Mani Kumar Tirumanadham

abstract: In today’s digital workspace, users are routinely able to access diverse information from numerous websites, which is a common practice for them to obtain multiple analyses, statistics, and factual content. To obtain specific information, including word definitions or executive summaries, people turn to internet searches or specific websites. Several existing systems use web scraping methodologies to extract targeted information from websites as part of this pursuit. The Beautiful Soup and Request Python libraries, which are well-known tools in this field, were utilized in this study. Beautiful Soup uses parser techniques to efficiently navigate web pages, allowing users to extract and gather the content they desire. Xtree model can be an efficient way to gather data, but it’s important to follow ethical conventions, maintain rules, and respect website regulations.

articleTitle: Empowering Conversations: An Innovative Recommendation Chatbot Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Chatbots have completely changed the way digital systems are engaged in tech-driven society.. By analyzing consumer data, behavior, and possibilities, chatbots provide timely and contextually relevant advice that is essential to generating more positive customer evaluations. This collaboration allows chatbots to make specific advice based on user preferences and choices, as well as engage in large-scale conversations.

articleTitle: Intelligent passenger coordination and management of urban rail transit based on network information analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: In response to the escalating transportation demand in urban areas due to population growth and urbanization, the development and efficient operation of urban rail transit systems have become crucial. This study proposes an innovative approach for intelligent passenger coordination and management in urban rail transit systems by utilizing advanced network information analysis techniques. Through comprehensive evaluation and analysis of the urban rail transit network, this research aims to optimize operational efficiency and improve service quality. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and analytical methods, the proposed methodology addresses existing challenges and improves the overall performance of urban rail transit systems. The study includes a thorough review of related work in intelligent transportation systems, followed by a detailed description of the proposed methodology, focusing on the technical foundations of rail transit networks and intelligent passenger coordination strategies. In addition, the study presents simulation results that demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in optimizing passenger flow management and improving the travel experience for urban residents.

articleTitle: Dynamic Energy Management and Carbon Footprint Mitigation using AI and IoT in Residential Communities
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Dynamic energy management and carbon footprint mitigation in residential communities are crucial for achieving sustainability goals. This research presents a novel algorithm, termed EnerGAIN, which integrates Bayesian Optimization and Random Forests within an AI and IoT framework. EnerGAIN aims to optimize energy consumption patterns while reducing carbon emissions in residential settings. Simulation analyses were conducted to evaluate the performance of EnerGAIN compared to existing algorithms. Key simulation metrics including energy efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and predictive accuracy were utilized for comparison. Results demonstrate that EnerGAIN outperforms existing algorithms in terms of energy optimization and carbon footprint reduction, showcasing its effectiveness in promoting sustainable energy practices in residential communities. This research contributes to the advancement of AI and IoT-driven solutions for dynamic energy management and carbon footprint mitigation, offering promising avenues for fostering environmentally conscious behaviors in residential settings.

articleTitle: Advanced Navigation Solutions for the Blind and Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research work examines into the world of helping blind individuals find their way using technology. The study analyses the working of ultrasound sensors which are highly popular in short-range analysis and see how it can be used to mimic human head movement which climates all limitations of previous research in terms of ultrasound sensor placement. A system with navigational aids which is made on a No-ARM chip for very less computational overload can also be found. A ultra-reliable edge detection method called canny edge detection is been examined with a real-life demo on various inputs. Through a comprehensive investigation of these technologies, a system is made with multipurpose use cases with a variety of features and characteristics. Altogether, this study seeks to provide valuable insights that can guide the improvement and optimization of assistive navigation aids.

articleTitle: Empowering Computer Network Security using K-Means Reinforcement Learning Resource Allocation (KRL-RA)
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: In today’s digital world, protecting network infrastructures from rapidly developing cyber threats is more important than ever. This research study focuses on introducing Artificial Intelligence-based approaches to optimize network security. It discusses how AI can enhance intrusion detection capabilities, traffic engineering policies, and resource allocation strategies. The vision is to build an innovative and effective network security architecture based on AI features that can predict attacks and enhance network performance through better resource management at high speeds. This research considers the inherent interdependence between traffic engineering and resource allocation in improving network performance. The research study improved the initial model of the k-mean clustering algorithm and combined it with other ML network security algorithms like Q-learning/Reinforcement Learning to give final proposed KRL-RA model. Various existing models of intrusion detection, network security, and resource allocation, are discussed and compared them to the improved version of the proposed KRL-RA model, which uses Machine Learning to improve its efficiency and reliability using past records. It is demonstrated with two different practical cases. Through iterative learning, the system obtains a better understanding of the network environment, leading to a greater intrusion detection success rate.

articleTitle: Automated Bird Species Identification using Audio Signal Processing and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Identifying bird species automatically has grown in importance across several domains, including conservation biology, biodiversity monitoring, and ornithology. Conventional techniques mostly rely on visual identification and manual observation, which can be laborious and time-consuming, particularly in large-scale monitoring initiatives. Automated bird species identification systems have been made possible in recent years by developments in neural network techniques and acoustic signal processing. This research work uses neural networks and acoustic signal processing to provide a novel automatic bird species identification method. Neural network architecture, feature representation, audio feature extraction, and model training are the main parts of the suggested system. Firstly, mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs), which are pertinent features, are extracted from audio recordings of bird vocalizations through pre-processing. A neural network model trained to categorize the input audio into several bird species categories is then given these features. The proposed approach is integrated with neural network topologies, such as convolutional neural network (CNN) as a proposed algorithm, to obtain reliable and accurate bird species categorization. Results from experiments on benchmark datasets shows the suggested methods efficiency in automatically identifying different species of birds. The recommended solution surpasses conventional techniques and achieves excellent accuracy, demonstrating its potential for practical use in bird monitoring and conservation initiatives. It is possible to extend the prospects for this field of study, like transfer learning to enhance model generalization across various environmental conditions and geographical locations and multi-modal fusion using extra sensor data.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Various Machine Learning Algorithms in Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Recommendation system has become an inevitable tool for businesses over the years. Its significance is widely recognized for both products as well as services. This study offers a thorough examination of several machine learning algorithms appropriate for recommendation systems designed for diverse domains, such as music and movies. Although there are several algorithms available for creating suggestions, some jobs may benefit from the use of a particular method. This article examines a number of basic and sophisticated algorithms used in recommendation systems, explains their applications, and analyses their advantages and disadvantages. This research compares the implementation of movie recommendation using single value decomposition plus-plus (SVD++) with popular machine learning techniques like k-nearest neighbor (K-NN) and singular value decomposition (SVD). Using the MovieLens 100 K and 1M datasets, it is experimentally proven by measurement of the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE). The outcome demonstrates that the SVD++ provides a lower error rate.

articleTitle: Aquatic Metrics: Exploring Quantity and Caliber Analysis using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)

authors.preferredName: N S S L Reshma Kondepudi

abstract: The integration of sensor technology within a water monitoring system facilitates simultaneous evaluation of water quantity and quality, providing real-time data on consumption patterns, turbidity, and pH levels. The proposed heterogeneous sensor network ensures a comprehensive understanding of water conditions to enable effective water quality management. Through a user-friendly web interface, the collected data is seamlessly transmitted, granting instant access to a centralized platform for analysis. The proposed Aquatic Caliber monitoring system’s sensors enable precise, real-time measurement of water purity, enhancing safety standards for drinking water by accurately assessing alkalinity, acidity, and turbidity levels while detecting impurities. This innovative approach holds significant potential to advance sustainability initiatives, revolutionize water quality management practices, and safeguard public health across diverse settings.

articleTitle: Multi Cancer Prediction using Deep Learning and CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Deep learning approach is used to predict the chance of acquiring several types of malignancies, including breast, brain, lung, colon, oral, kidney, and cervical cancer. To find patterns and risk factors linked to each kind of cancer, deep learning algorithms, such as convolutional neural networks and recurrent neural networks, are trained on enormous databases of patient data, including genetic markers, lifestyle variables, and medical history. Deep learning algorithms can accurately forecast an individual’s risk of acquiring cervical, lung, colon, oral, kidney, breast, or brain cancer by evaluating these intricate datasets. Results indicate varied performance across cancer types, with cervical, breast, lung, and colon cancer models exhibiting high accuracy (>98%) and lower validation losses, suggesting strong generalization capabilities. Conversely, kidney and oral cancer models displayed signs of overfitting, emphasizing the challenges of model generalization. These findings highlights the DL’s potential in enhancing cancer detection, early diagnosis, and personalized treatment planning.

articleTitle: A Privacy Preserving Sentiment Analysis using Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research is conducted with the objective of creating and presenting a system, which is a federated framework capable of classifying and encrypting social media data, to provide the most accurate sentiment of customer feedback and understand their needs. Traditionally, the method used for sentiment analysis faces challenges in accurately classifying sentiments and also in maintaining the privacy in the system. The aim is to create a system that provides highly accurate sentiment predictions while maintaining or preserving the privacy of the data providing sources using federated learning. The proposed framework uses social media sites such as twitter, Facebook, etc. as hotspots for the collection of information of customer sentiments regarding consumer items, information is filtered and processed using natural language processing, Deep learning models for classifying the sentiment of the text corpus to identify –"what the consumer is trying to say". Finally a federated learning framework creates a network between the global model and the local models that are present at the data sources. Privacy Preserving because the model weights are encrypted prior to training the global model thereby ensuring data privacy between the models. The outcome is an improvement on the traditional sentiment analysis approach where instead of training a model on one data corpus, multiple models are trained on different datasets and converge the results into a global model. The system has proved to be better than current Sentiment Analysis approach while keeping the data privacy between multiple models and devices.

articleTitle: 5G News Empowers State Grid to Redefine News Dissemination Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The advent of 5G networks has catalyzed a paradigm shift in the field of communication, necessitating a reevaluation of news dissemination methods, especially in the context of State Grid. This research seeks to explore the integration of cutting-edge 5G technology to enable State Grid to redefine its news dissemination channels. By leveraging the unprecedented speed, reliability, and connectivity of 5G communications, this study proposes a novel real-time tracking system tailored for cold chain logistics bases. This system aims not only to revolutionize the efficiency and effectiveness of news dissemination, but also to address the evolving demands and complexities of modern communication ecosystems. Through an exhaustive review of relevant literature and an intricate architectural design, this study lays a solid foundation for a transformative approach to news dissemination within the State Grid infrastructure.

articleTitle: Deep Vision: Lane Detection in ITS: A Deep Learning Segmentation Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) are critical for enhancing urban mobility and safety in smart cities. The accuracy of lane detection, a fundamental component of ITS, significantly impacts its effectiveness. Traditional lane detection methods often falter under dynamic urban conditions, such as varying lighting and weather. This study introduces a novel deep learning-based image segmentation framework that leverages state-of-the-art neural networks to improve lane detection accuracy. Proposed approach integrates advancements in convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with image segmentation techniques, resulting in a system capable of precise lane identification under a variety of conditions. Through rigorous evaluation on the TuSimple and Udacity datasets, which include a wide range of urban driving scenarios, proposed models, including Unet and SegNet, demonstrate superior performance with accuracy improvements up to 97.62%, outperforming existing methods like LaneNet. This research paves the way for safer and more efficient ITS by providing a robust solution to the challenges of real-time lane detection in complex and variable environments.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Misconfiguration-SAAS Security Threat
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Cloud computing is a rapidly advancing technology that leverages internet resources for optimal computing capabilities. Service providers in the cloud domain strive to maximize resource efficiency through various service models. This scenario presents distinctive hurdles, which call for joint endeavors involving researchers from both IT and information security domains to tackle and rectify these challenges. This article explores the inherent dangers linked with cloud computing paradigms, with a particular emphasis on the security framework of Software-as-a-Service (SaaS). It offers an in-depth examination of the variables impacting SaaS security. It is crucial to tackle these security concerns during the design and development phases of cloud SaaS applications. This approach aims to establish a secure, compliant, and trustworthy environment for users engaging with cloud SaaS. This research work serves as a valuable resource for an indepth exploration of SaaS security, highlighting vulnerabilities and addressing security threats. Researchers can benefit from the insights provided here as they delve into the intricate landscape of cloud computing security.

articleTitle: Enhancing Credit Card Security: Exploiting Machine Learning for Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The threat of credit card theft is growing as more and more companies move their payment operations online. Online transaction vulnerabilities are being exploited by fraudsters using a variety of advanced approaches. The goal is to apply a wide range of machine learning techniques to accurately distinguish between legitimate and fraudulent transactions. Algorithms may be customized for each category by carefully classifying transactions into different categories. It will be possible to select the classifier that is the best accurate at detecting fraudulent transactions by independently training different classifiers on these groups. A dataset including credit card transactions made online by anonymous users is the foundation of the research. It is noteworthy that there is a notable imbalance in this dataset, with the bulk of transactions being authentic, and a negligible percentage being fake.

articleTitle: Detection of Autism Spectrum Disorder using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a serious developmental disorder that involves problems with social interaction and communication, as well as repetitive behavior. Early diagnosis and treatment are key to improving the lives of people with autism. One recent breakthrough in the field involves the use of cutting-edge machine learning algorithms to automatically identify ASD using different kinds of data like behavioral observations. The proposed approach combines various types of deep learning models such as YOLOv8n, Detectron2, VGG16, ResNet50, Xception, Inceptionv3, and MobileNetV2. Using these models’ capabilities, the goal of the research study is to increase the distinction between ASD-related behavior signals and normal development patterns. The effectiveness of our method was demonstrated by test results which showed it was highly accurate.

articleTitle: Technological Innovations and Practical Applications of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles in Intelligent Urban Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The use of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in intelligent urban planning has become increasingly important, offering advanced imaging capabilities and facilitating the implementation of cutting-edge technologies such as image classification and change detection. This study explores the technological innovations and practical applications of UAVs in urban planning, focusing on the development of novel image analysis algorithms. By integrating advanced airborne imagers with drone platforms, the study proposes innovative approaches for image classification and change detection using deep learning methods. The proposed algorithms are rigorously evaluated through extensive experiments, demonstrating their effectiveness in improving the accuracy and efficiency of urban planning processes. The results highlights the potential of UAV-based techniques to revolutionize urban planning practices, paving the way for sustainable and informed decision-making in complex urban environments.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Conversational AI: The Multimodal Frontier in Chatbot System Advancements
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This research study analyses the evolution of conversational AI, focusing on the integration of multi-modal systems that incorporate text, audio, and visual data to create more dynamic dialogue systems. By considering the significance of visual information in enhancing Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), this study explores early developments in the field. This study discusses about the optimization of these models by using techniques such as reinforcement learning and multi-task learning along with the use of data fusion methods to effectively integrate multimodal inputs. Key research gaps are identified, particularly the need for improved emotional intelligence and handling of diverse input modalities. This research study concludes by highlighting the potential of advanced approaches such as adversarial machine learning and transfer learning in addressing current limitations and shaping the future trajectory of conversational AI.

articleTitle: Smart Charging Slot Reservation and Utilization System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: An innovative infrastructure called the Smart Charging Slot Reservation and Utilization System for Electric Vehicles was created to maximize resource management and user convenience while streamlining the charging process for electric vehicles (EVs). This cutting-edge solution combines IoT technologies and a strong software ecosystem with hardware and software components. Fundamentally, the system offers EV charging stations with Internet of Things (IoT) capabilities, enabling remote control and monitoring. Through an easy-to- use webpage, users may find charging outlets in their immediate vicinity. Users may easily schedule and pay for charging services using the webpage. The system’s capability to deliver real-time information on available charging slots at different stations is one of its primary advantages. Flexible slots can be reserved by users according to variables like peak hour timing, vehicle type, and charging station capacity. Furthermore, the system utilizes an algorithm to determine the anticipated charging duration, guaranteeing effective resource management. Additionally, the system uses peak-hour power reduction technology, which aids in controlling energy use during times of high demand. This lessens the load on the electrical grid, which helps with ecological initiatives while also increasing charging efficiency. Moreover, the system has built-in GPS mapping capabilities, which make it simple for users to find the closest charging station. All things considered, this innovative approach is a major step forward for the infrastructure of EV charging, improving accessibility and fostering sustainability by managing peak hours and using renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Constructing Co-Occurrence Graphs and Deriving Flood Ontologies for Enhanced Understanding
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Developing ontologies traditionally requires significant expertise and time investment. The research study proposes an approach to automate the construction of flood ontologies from textual documents using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and ontology learning. The research work presents an algorithm specifically designed to extract relevant concepts and relationships from flood-related documents, facilitating the automatic generation of ontologies. By constructing co-occurrence graphs and employing the proposed algorithm, the proposed approach aims to uncover implicit knowledge embedded within textual data, thus enhancing understanding and enabling more efficient ontology construction. The significance of this work lies in its potential to streamline the process of building flood ontologies, reducing the reliance on domain experts and accelerating the pace of ontology development. The proposed approach empowers researchers and practitioners to quickly identify key concepts and relationships relevant to flood management and research. This, in turn, can facilitate more effective decision-making and resource allocation in flood-prone areas.

articleTitle: Pose Detection with Corrective Feedback to Aid Physiotherapy for Parkinson’s Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a degenerative neurological condition affecting the nervous system and the body's nerve-controlled regions. Studies have shown that consistent physiotherapy can reduce the effects for early-stage patients. The problem- patients do not have access to physiotherapists at all time convenient to them, and the lack of access to a physiotherapist could mean the patient performs exercises by themselves incorrectly or not perform them at all, which could possibly worsen the patient’s condition. Related work focuses on exercise correction, but no emphasis on Parkinson’s Disease as a niche. This research study proposes a novel solution to this, by offering an application that aids in performing exercises tailor-made for Parkinson’s patients, detecting anomaly in exercise performance, and providing corrective feedback in the form of text, and audio, using machine learning.

articleTitle: ML based Projector to Smart Board Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The study presents an approach to convert traditional projectors into interactive smart boards using machine learning techniques. Leveraging deep learning models SSDMobileNetV2, EfficientNet, and Fast R-CNN, combined with open-source libraries such as PyAutoGUI and OpenCV, the system accurately localizes user fingers, detects touch events, and translates these inputs into seamless interactions with projected content. Rigorous analysis demonstrates commendable performance metrics, including high accuracy in finger localization, real-time responsiveness, and cost-effectiveness. Real-time testing confirms the system’s practical applicability and efficiency, showcasing its potential to revolutionize interactive presentations, collaborative learning activities, and user engagement with projected content in educational and professional environments.

articleTitle: Smart System for Elderly Care Based on Portable Sensor Positioning and Video Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: As the global aging population increases, there is a growing need for innovative solutions to provide efficient and personalized care for the elderly. In response to this need, this study introduces a novel smart elderly care system based on wearable sensor positioning and video monitoring technology. The system integrates advanced sensor technology and video surveillance to track and monitor the activities of elderly individuals in real time, thereby enhancing their safety, well-being, and quality of life. The proposed system utilizes state-of-the-art algorithms, including trilateration for sensor positioning and target regression prediction using long short-term memory (LSTM) models for video surveillance. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the system in terms of tracking accuracy and localization, with precision curves showing fluctuations due to different experimental scenarios and noise levels. The robustness of the system and its potential for performance optimization are also discussed, highlighting the importance of fine-tuning parameters for real-world applications. In addition, the study addresses challenges such as social isolation, health monitoring, and caregiver shortage, highlighting the role of technology in addressing these issues. The proposed smart system offers a comprehensive and efficient solution for elderly care, contributing to improving the quality of life of older adults and alleviating societal and family burdens associated with aging.

articleTitle: Aircraft Engine Fault Detection Algorithm Based on Multivariate Time Series Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of civil air transportation, ensuring the safety and reliability of aircraft engines remains a critical concern. This study presents a novel aircraft engine fault detection algorithm based on multivariate time series sensor data, with the aim of enhancing the reliability and safety of air transportation. The proposed algorithm utilizes advanced data analysis techniques and intelligent algorithms to accurately predict potential engine failures, thereby facilitating proactive maintenance and minimizing aircraft delays. The study reviews state-of-the-art methods in aircraft engine fault detection, highlighting advances in dynamic radius support vector data description, modified moving window kernel principal component analysis, hybrid extended Kalman filter, and cross-domain guided learning methods, among others. In addition, the study proposes a comprehensive methodology for aircraft engine fault detection that integrates sensor data acquisition, pre-processing, fault detection algorithms, and performance optimization using multivariate time series analysis. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in achieving high detection rates and specificity for known fault types, while addressing challenges related to computational complexity and generalization.

articleTitle: Cloud Transformation and the Key Concerns for Cloud Security and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Cloud transformation has become a pivotal strategy for organizations seeking to leverage the advantages of cloud computing. This process involves migrating IT infrastructure, applications, and data to cloud platforms to enhance scalability, flexibility, and cost-efficiency. However, as organizations embrace cloud technologies, cloud security is a paramount concern. Protecting data and resources in the cloud requires robust identity and access management, encryption, network security, and compliance adherence. Yet, alongside the potential benefits, cloud transformation presents its unique set of challenges. Managing cloud costs, ensuring data migration without disruption, maintaining performance and reliability, and avoiding vendor lock-in are among the challenges organizations must address. This research work highlights the critical importance of striking a balance between cloud transformation and cloud security, while navigating the complex landscape of cloud challenges to ensure a successful and secure cloud journey.

articleTitle: Environment Prediction System for Smart Greenhouses using IoT-based Spatial Monitoring Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study introduces a data-driven climate prediction model for greenhouses, leveraging a cost-effective Internet of Things (IoT) spatial monitoring system. The IoT infrastructure, comprising data collection, transmission, analysis, and visualization stages, was deployed and tested in a real greenhouse over three months, focusing on temperature, humidity, CO2 levels, and rain levels. The model demonstrated a 24-hour prediction advantage, enhancing accuracy and enabling adjustments for optimal plant growth conditions. A spatial monitoring strategy based on packing density theory addresses climate variability within greenhouses striking a balance between effectiveness and cost. Real-world testing validated the system’s efficacy, making it accessible to a wide range of greenhouse operators. The integration of IoT technology in agriculture presents a significant step towards sustainable and efficient practices to meet the rising global demand for food.

articleTitle: Protein sequence prediction research using machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Sequence data mining, known for its application in various fields, especially bioinformatics, plays a pivotal role in unraveling complex biological phenomena. This study presents an innovative methodology for protein sequence prediction using advanced machine learning algorithms. By integrating similarity modeling, hidden Markov models, and neural networks, the study provides a comprehensive framework for protein domain prediction. In particular, novel techniques such as ExtendProfile and ProfileAA encoding are introduced to improve feature extraction, while Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks facilitate the capture of long-term dependencies within protein sequences. Extensive experimentation, including single and multi-domain prediction scenarios, demonstrates compelling performance across a range of thresholds. The results demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the model, with precision ranging from 0.859 to 0.893, recall from 0.718 to 0.755, accuracy from 0.888 to 0.920, MCC from 0.845 to 0.897, NDO from 0.913 to 0.920, and DBD from 0.845 to 0.897. In addition to advancing computational biology research, this study provides practical insights into protein sequence prediction, paving the way for transformative applications in bioinformatics and beyond.

articleTitle: A Model for Predicting Chronic Renal Failure using CatBoost Classifier Algorithm and XGBClassifier
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Chronic Renal Failure (CRF) is expected to be the sixth greatest reason for demise globally. A persistent estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of less than 4.05768 tablespoon in 3600 seconds of average surface area for an adult is a serious concern associated with the problem of persistent renal illness by 2040. For older citizens, this limit may exceed 30 mg or more per day nearly in the span of three months or more. Improving Global Outcomes from Kidney Disease the 2012 recommendations defined CRF and the risk of progression based on both the degree of albuminuria and the eGFR, which will result in severe problems for future generations. The proposed research work aims to create and verify a prediction model for persistent renal illness. The algorithms used in machine learning are commonly employed in medication to forecast and categorize illnesses. Medical records are often distorted. It helps to forecast the disease in its early stages in order to save lives. The research work utilizes chronic renal disease dataset with twenty-five characteristics and two machine learning classifiers to predict and analyze. The CatBoost Classifier method and the XGB Classifiers technique may be utilized to enhance the machine learning model's output. The top eight ranking characteristics from the chronic renal illness dataset were utilized to create a new machine learning classifier that is more accurate and predictive. Lastly, information on chronic kidney sickness is gathered, classified, and comprises various attributes. The XGB classifier and CatBoost classifier offer the best results, with an accuracy of 99.00% and 99.645%, compared to the other machine models. When a disease is recognized early enough, the diagnosis model may operate as a medical adviser, initiating treatment on time, at a lower cost, and saving lives.

Author Keywords: Gradient-boosting algorithm and Light BGM algorithm

articleTitle: Adaptive Deep Ensemble Learning for Robust Network Intrusion Detection in Industrial IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Network security remains a critical concern in the context of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) deployments, where interconnected devices facilitate data exchange and automation in industrial settings. As the IIoT ecosystem continues to expand, the vulnerability surface for potential cyber threats widens, necessitating robust security measures to safeguard sensitive industrial infrastructure and operations. In the Industrial Internet of Things domain, ensuring robust network security is paramount. The research study presents an innovative approach, termed DeepResNetEnsemble (DRNE), which amalgamates the resilience of Residual Networks (ResNet) with ensemble learning techniques to fortify network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) in IIoT environments. The proposed DRNE model adapts dynamically to evolving threats by utlilizing the collective intelligence of multiple deep learning representations. To evaluate the efficacy of DRNE, extensive simulations were conducted using the KDDCUP99 dataset, a benchmark dataset widely employed for intrusion detection research. Through comparative analysis, DRNE achieves high performance metrics, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score than conventional single-model approaches and other ensemble methods. Notably, DRNE exhibits remarkable adaptability to diverse intrusion scenarios, making it well-suited for deployment in dynamic IIoT networks.

articleTitle: A Comparative Literature Analysis Framework (CLAF) Utilizing Data Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel Comparative Literature Analysis Framework (CLAF) that utilizes data mining algorithms to assess semantic similarities among diverse textual sources in the field of literature. The framework integrates various methodologies including semantic plot modeling, an improved seq2seq algorithm, and topic identification models such as Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and Sentence-BERT (S-BERT). Through the careful application of these methods, the framework facilitates narrative comprehension, semantic extraction, and topic identification, thereby enabling comprehensive analysis of textual data. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in achieving high precision and recall rates compared to established methods such as LDA and BERT. Moreover, the CLAF provides a versatile approach that can be extended to various domains beyond literature analysis, thus contributing to the advancement of data-driven decision-making paradigms.

articleTitle: Virtual Glamour: AI-Enhanced Makeup Recommendations and Trials
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: The Makeup Recommendation System is a tribute to the potential of data-driven technology to improve the user experience in the ever-changing world of beauty and cosmetics. This unique technology creates personalised designs for cosmetics, skin care items and makeup application techniques using complex algorithms and data analysis methodologies. This method not only speeds up shopping, but also allows users to make informed decisions about their beauty products and procedures by considering the user’s unique characteristics such as skin type, complexion, personal preferences and the latest beauty trends. The technology also dives deep into personal preferences to provide a personalised experience that matches an individual’s own interests. This level of customization ensures that the recommendations are not only relevant, but also resonate with the consumer on a deeper level. Users can experiment with different lip colors, eyeshadows and foundations, and thanks to the excellent images, they can see the possible results as if they were physically doing the makeup. The Makeup Recommendation System helps users make more confident makeup decisions by providing personalised recommendations and a virtual trial experience. It not only makes shopping easier, but also fosters a stronger bond between people and their beauty products. This in turn improves the overall user experience, making beauty shopping enjoyable and stress-free.By accurately applying numerous makeup styles to users’ faces, this makeup transfer application’s outcomes aim to enhance the realism of photos. This technology allows users to see realistic previews of various makeup styles before making a purchase, and it finds uses in the production of cosmetic products and virtual makeup try-on experiences.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-Party Computation in Data Security and Privacy Protection under the Context of Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Blockchain technology has significant implications for data security and privacy. However, the decentralized structure of blockchain networks poses challenges for ensuring data security and privacy. This study investigates the use of multi-party computation (MPC) to improve data security and privacy in blockchain environments. A comprehensive analysis of recent literature on blockchain security is conducted, highlighting various security vulnerabilities and proposed solutions. A novel methodology is proposed that integrates MPC and federated learning to mitigate data security and privacy concerns within blockchain networks. A consensus mechanism is designed to leverage MPC to achieve input privacy and output correctness, ensuring efficient and secure data processing. Furthermore, homomorphic encryption (HE) and differential privacy (DP) techniques are integrated to enhance data security and privacy. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed methodology in terms of computational efficiency, communication overhead, and security detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Modeling Intrusion Detection for the Landscape Design Software Procreate from Data Layer
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: In today's digital landscape, network security faces escalating challenges with the proliferation of cyber threats. Intrusion detection is a central defense mechanism against these threats, requiring constant innovation and refinement. This study presents a novel approach to modeling intrusion detection specifically tailored to Procreate, a landscape design software, with a focus on the data layer. Leveraging machine learning and deep learning techniques, proposed methodology encompasses comprehensive steps including feature selection, data processing, and model implementation. Through experimentation and comparison with the traditional methods, the proposed model demonstrates superior performance in terms of accuracy, error rate, recall rate, precision, F-measure, AUC, and computational efficiency. The results highlight the effectiveness of proposed approach in enhancing network security for Procreate users and provide valuable insights for future research directions.

articleTitle: PAN Card Tampering Detection using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: In an era dominated by digital transactions and an increasing reliance on electronic identity verification, the need for robust security measures has become important. As people and organizations increasingly undertake financial transactions, deal with sensitive data, and perform numerous online activities, the vulnerability to cybersecurity risks and identity fraud has become a serious concern. The machine learning-based PAN card tampering detection system offers an innovative solution to address the growing issue of identity fraud and document manipulation, particularly within the financial and government sectors. The dataset consists of 40 real and 40 fake PAN cards and also 20 real and 9 fake Aadhar cards. The system uses CNNs, a specific type of deep learning model intended for image processing, to mitigate this problem. The performance of CNN is also compared against various pretrained models like ResNet50, VGG16, Xception and MobileNetV2. After thorough analysis, this study concluded that CNN is the best performing model with an accuracy of 100%, loss 0.14% and average execution time of 0.24%. It meticulously analyzes any discrepancies and variations such as alterations intext, wrong numerical data and tampering with the photos. The incorporation of CNN into this novel system not only resolves the existing vulnerabilities related to PAN cards but also lays the groundwork for an identity verification environment that is both more secure and reliable in the context of financial and governmental transactions.

articleTitle: Exploring the Application of Multi-Objective Optimization Algorithms in Logistics Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: This study explores the application of multi-objective optimization algorithms in logistics sensor networks, with a particular focus on real-time tracking in cold chain logistics. Leveraging technologies such as RFID, sensor networks, and intelligent computing, the study proposes efficient solutions for inventory management, route optimization, and smart logistics. The proposed HEMO-MRSS algorithm addresses the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) to minimize the number of vehicles and increase efficiency. Through a comprehensive literature review, recent advances in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are examined and their contributions to various domains are highlighted. The methodology section describes the design of logistics systems with sensors and the application of multi-objective optimization algorithms, and presents a detailed model for integrated vehicle routing with time windows. The simulation, performed on a Windows 11 system, evaluates the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms using four evaluation metrics.
