The results show improved performance under optimized conditions, especially in the mean and optimal values, suggesting the importance of optimization in improving algorithmic efficiency in logistics sensor networks.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Decision Support System for Sustainable Energy Management: An AI-IoT Fusion Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Sustainable energy management involves the strategic planning, implementation, and optimization of energy resources to meet present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own energy requirements. It encompasses various activities, including energy generation, distribution, consumption, and conservation, with the overarching goal of minimizing environmental impact while ensuring economic viability and social equity. The study presents a novel Data-Driven Decision Support System (DDDSS) designed for Sustainable Energy Management (SEM) through an innovative AI-IoT Fusion Approach. This approach integrates Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques with Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to enhance the efficiency and sustainability of energy management systems. A key component of the proposed system is the SmartARIMA algorithm, which amalgamates AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) principles to predict energy demand and optimize resource allocation in real-time. To evaluate the effectiveness of the SmartARIMA algorithm, simulation analyses are conducted and compared with suitable existing algorithms using appropriate metrics. These metrics include mean absolute percentage error, forecast accuracy and scalability. The simulation results demonstrate that the SmartARIMA algorithm outperforms traditional algorithms in terms of accuracy and adaptability, thereby enabling more effective decision-making in sustainable energy management. The proposed DDDSS framework, leveraging the SmartARIMA algorithm within an AI-IoT fusion context, offers a promising solution for addressing the challenges of sustainable energy management. By harnessing the power of AI and IoT technologies, organizations can optimize energy consumption, reduce waste, and promote environmental sustainability. The findings of this research contribute to the advancement of data-driven approaches in sustainable energy management and provide valuable insights for practitioners and researchers alike.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Navigating the Web 3.0 Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI)
abstract: Web 3.0 represents a significant evolution of the internet. It aims to create a proper online environment and enhance the online experience through the utilization of AI and Blockchain. In the early days, internet (Web 1.0) was basic, and the interactive internet (Web 2.0) where people started chatting and sharing contents.. Now, with Web 3.0, which uses technologies like blockchain ensure the safety and trust in online actions.s and there is a Decentralized Apps (DApps) where no one has complete control. Decentralized Identity (DID) allows to have more control over the online identity. The approach is to make easier for different websites and apps to communicate with each other, which helps to create smarter online conversations and a stronger online environment... It helps in making online content more personal and helps to find things better.,even making chatbots and virtual helpers that are easier to use. It is made sure that using blockchain doesn't cause problems with privacy or the environment. However, Web 3.0 has the potential to make big changes in areas like money, health, and education. It could make financial systems better with platforms like DeFi and make sharing information in healthcare safer. To make sure Web 3.0 keeps getting better, continuous research and advanced technology should be improved. This will help to solve any problems and make sure the internet becomes more fair, efficient, and trustworthy for the user..
